//      turn on or turn off this effect.
// 
// **********************************************************************************
// **********************     FLAG FOR FLICKER NOISE CORNERS SIMULATION  ************
// 
//  NOTE:
//   1. Transistor
//      noiseflagn=0 for typical, noiseflagn=1 for worstcase, noiseflagn=-1 for 
//  best case
//      noiseflagp=0 for typical, noiseflagp=1 for worstcase, noiseflagp=-1 for 
//  best case
//   2. Resistor
//      rnoiseflag=0 for typical, rnoiseflag=1 for worstcase, rnoiseflag=-1 for 
//  best case
// 
// **********************************************************************************
// **********************    VBD REVERSE BIAS RANGE FOR 5V SVT DEVICE  ***************
// 
// NOTE:
//   1. The VBD Reverse Bias range for 5V N/PMOS transistors should be < N+/PW 
//  & P+/NW BV value ~ 8V.  *
//  
// *********************************************************************************** 
//

}
}
endsection stat_noise

+ * geo_fac * toxp * fac2 * mismatchflag

inline subckt pch_iso25_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) 
parameters l=1u w=1u multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 sigma=1 dmcg=2.05e-007 dmci=3.15e-007 
+ xw= + 0 + dxwp ad=(nf * dmcg + dmci) / factor * (w / nf + xw / factor) as=(nf 
+ * dmcg + dmci) / factor * (w / nf + xw / factor) pd=2 * (nf * dmcg + dmci) / factor 
+ + (nf + 1) * (w / nf + xw / factor) ps=2 * (nf * dmcg + dmci) / factor + (nf + 
+ 1) * (w / nf + xw / factor) nrd=dmcg / factor / nf / (w / nf + xw / factor) nrs=dmcg 
+ / factor / nf / (w / nf + xw / factor) sa=1.00e-05 / factor sb=1.00e-05 / factor 
+ sd=2 * dmcg / factor sca=0e-6 / factor scb=0e-6 / factor scc=0e-6 / factor mismatchflag=mismatchflag_mos 
+ temp1=par1p temp2=par2p fac1=0.754208 * temp1 * sigma + 0.656636 * temp2 * sigma 
+ fac2=0.754208 * temp1 * sigma - 0.656636 * temp2 * sigma lef=l * factor - 1.5e-08 
+ wef=w / nf * factor + 0 geo_fac=1 / sqrt(multi * nf * lef * wef * 1e12) vthmisp=0.00315499 
+ * geo_fac * fac1 * mismatchflag dlmisp=0.00204053 * geo_fac * lef * fac2 * mismatchflag 
+ dwmisp= - 0.00204053 * geo_fac * wef * fac2 * mismatchflag toxmisp=0.00204053 
+ * geo_fac * toxp * fac2 * mismatchflag

+ nf=nf sa=sa sb=sb sd=sd sca=sca scb=scb scc=scc

+ * (log(4.472) - min(0,0.5 * log(pwr(((w * factor * l * factor * multi) / (5e-6 
+ * 0.5e-6 * 32)),0.5)))) noiapmac=c1fp * pwr(2.718,((noiseflagp_mc * par1fn_mc 
+ + (1 - noiseflagp_mc) * noiseflagp) * arearatio)) noibpmac=c2fp * pwr(2.718,((noiseflagp_mc

inline subckt pch_5_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) 
parameters l=1u w=1u multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 sigma=1 dmcg=2e-007 dmci=2e-007 
+ xw=1e-08 + dxwp_5 ad=(nf * dmcg + dmci) / factor * (w / nf + xw / factor) as=(nf 
+ * dmcg + dmci) / factor * (w / nf + xw / factor) pd=2 * (nf * dmcg + dmci) / factor 
+ + (nf + 1) * (w / nf + xw / factor) ps=2 * (nf * dmcg + dmci) / factor + (nf + 
+ 1) * (w / nf + xw / factor) nrd=dmcg / factor / nf / (w / nf + xw / factor) nrs=dmcg 
+ / factor / nf / (w / nf + xw / factor) sa=1.000000e-05 / factor sb=1.000000e-05 
+ / factor sd=2 * dmcg / factor sca=0e-6 / factor scb=0e-6 / factor scc=0e-6 / factor 
+ mismatchflag=mismatchflag_mos_5 lef=(l) * factor wef=(w / nf) * factor temp1=par1p_5 
+ temp2=par2p_5 temp3=par3p_5 temp4=par4p_5 temp5=par5p_5 mis_a_1=-0.00562 mis_a_2=-0.14 
+ mis_a_3=0.035 mis_b_1=0.0015 mis_b_2=-0.15 mis_b_3=0.25 mis_c_1=1 mis_c_2=0 mis_c_3=0 
+ mis_d_1=4.97e-03 mis_d_2=0 mis_d_3=0 mis_e_1=0.0044 mis_e_2=-0.16 mis_e_3=0.18 
+ e_limit=2 mis_f_1=1.125e-03 mis_f_2=0 mis_f_3=0 a=mis_a_1 * pow(lef * 1e6,mis_a_2) 
+ * pow(wef * 1e6,mis_a_3) b=mis_b_1 * pow(lef * 1e6,mis_b_2) * pow(wef * 1e6,mis_b_3) 
+ c=mis_c_1 * pow(lef * 1e6,mis_c_2) * pow(wef * 1e6,mis_c_3) d=mis_d_1 * pow(lef 
+ * 1e6,mis_d_2) * pow(wef * 1e6,mis_d_3) e=mis_e_1 * pow(lef * 1e6,mis_e_2) * pow(wef 
+ * 1e6,mis_e_3) f=mis_f_1 * pow(lef * 1e6,mis_f_2) * pow(wef * 1e6,mis_f_3) fac1=temp1 
+ fac2=temp2 fac3=temp3 fac4=temp4 fac5=c * temp4 + sqrt(1 - c * c) * temp5 geo_fac=1 
+ / sqrt(multi * nf * lef * wef * 1e12) * mismatchflag * sigma toxmisp_5=d * geo_fac 
+ * toxp_5 * fac1 dxlmisp_5=b * geo_fac * lef * fac2 dxwmisp_5= - b * geo_fac * 
+ wef * fac3 dvthmisp_5=a * geo_fac * fac4 fu0misp_5=min(e_limit,1 + e * geo_fac 
+ * fac5) dk2misp_5=f * geo_fac * fac5

inline subckt pch_5iso25_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) 
parameters l=1u w=1u multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 sigma=1 dmcg=2e-007 dmci=2e-007 
+ xw=1e-08 + dxwp_5 ad=(nf * dmcg + dmci) / factor * (w / nf + xw / factor) as=(nf 
+ * dmcg + dmci) / factor * (w / nf + xw / factor) pd=2 * (nf * dmcg + dmci) / factor 
+ + (nf + 1) * (w / nf + xw / factor) ps=2 * (nf * dmcg + dmci) / factor + (nf + 
+ 1) * (w / nf + xw / factor) nrd=dmcg / factor / nf / (w / nf + xw / factor) nrs=dmcg 
+ / factor / nf / (w / nf + xw / factor) sa=1.000000e-05 / factor sb=1.000000e-05 
+ / factor sd=2 * dmcg / factor sca=0e-6 / factor scb=0e-6 / factor scc=0e-6 / factor 
+ mismatchflag=mismatchflag_mos_5 lef=(l) * factor wef=(w / nf) * factor temp1=par1p_5 
+ temp2=par2p_5 temp3=par3p_5 temp4=par4p_5 temp5=par5p_5 mis_a_1=-0.00562 mis_a_2=-0.14 
+ mis_a_3=0.035 mis_b_1=0.0015 mis_b_2=-0.15 mis_b_3=0.25 mis_c_1=1 mis_c_2=0 mis_c_3=0 
+ mis_d_1=4.97e-03 mis_d_2=0 mis_d_3=0 mis_e_1=0.0044 mis_e_2=-0.16 mis_e_3=0.18 
+ e_limit=2 mis_f_1=1.125e-03 mis_f_2=0 mis_f_3=0 a=mis_a_1 * pow(lef * 1e6,mis_a_2) 
+ * pow(wef * 1e6,mis_a_3) b=mis_b_1 * pow(lef * 1e6,mis_b_2) * pow(wef * 1e6,mis_b_3) 
+ c=mis_c_1 * pow(lef * 1e6,mis_c_2) * pow(wef * 1e6,mis_c_3) d=mis_d_1 * pow(lef 
+ * 1e6,mis_d_2) * pow(wef * 1e6,mis_d_3) e=mis_e_1 * pow(lef * 1e6,mis_e_2) * pow(wef 
+ * 1e6,mis_e_3) f=mis_f_1 * pow(lef * 1e6,mis_f_2) * pow(wef * 1e6,mis_f_3) fac1=temp1 
+ fac2=temp2 fac3=temp3 fac4=temp4 fac5=c * temp4 + sqrt(1 - c * c) * temp5 geo_fac=1 
+ / sqrt(multi * nf * lef * wef * 1e12) * mismatchflag * sigma toxmisp_5=d * geo_fac 
+ * toxp_5 * fac1 dxlmisp_5=b * geo_fac * lef * fac2 dxwmisp_5= - b * geo_fac * 
+ wef * fac3 dvthmisp_5=a * geo_fac * fac4 fu0misp_5=min(e_limit,1 + e * geo_fac 
+ * fac5) dk2misp_5=f * geo_fac * fac5

inline subckt pch5_lvt_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 sigma=1
+dmcg=2e-007 dmci=2e-007 xw=1e-08+dxwp_5_lvt
+ad=(nf*dmcg+dmci)/factor*(w/nf+xw/factor) as=(nf*dmcg+dmci)/factor*(w/nf+xw/factor)
+pd=2*(nf*dmcg+dmci)/factor+(nf+1)*(w/nf+xw/factor) ps=2*(nf*dmcg+dmci)/factor+(nf+1)*(w/nf+xw/factor)
+nrd=dmcg/factor/nf/(w/nf+xw/factor) nrs=dmcg/factor/nf/(w/nf+xw/factor)
+sa=0/factor sb=0/factor sd=2*dmcg/factor sca=0e-6/factor scb=0e-6/factor scc=0e-6/factor
+mismatchflag=mismatchflag_mos_5_lvt
pch5_lvt_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) pch5_lvt w=w  l=l  ad=ad  as=as  pd=pd  ps=ps  nrd=nrd  nrs=nrs  m=multi  nf=nf  sa=sa  sb=sb  sd=sd  sca=sca  scb=scb  scc=scc
//**** mismatch ***
parameters
+lef=(l)*factor 
+wef=(w/nf)*factor 
+temp1=par1p_lvt  temp2=par2p_lvt  temp3=par3p_lvt  temp4=par4p_lvt  temp5=par5p_lvt 

+mis_a_1=-0.008   mis_a_2=-0.05   mis_a_3=-0.05 
+mis_b_1=0.0023   mis_b_2=0.03   mis_b_3=0.35 
+mis_c_1=1    mis_c_2=0    mis_c_3=0 
+mis_d_1=0.005    mis_d_2=0  mis_d_3=0 
+mis_e_1=0.0023   mis_e_2=0       mis_e_3=0   e_limit=2

+a=mis_a_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_a_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_a_3) 
+b=mis_b_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_b_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_b_3) 
+c=mis_c_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_c_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_c_3) 
+d=mis_d_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_d_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_d_3) 
+e=mis_e_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_e_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_e_3) 

+fac1=temp1 
+fac2=temp2 
+fac3=temp3 
+fac4=temp4 
+fac5=c*temp4+sqrt(1-c*c)*temp5 

+geo_fac=1/sqrt(multi*nf*lef*wef*1e12)*mismatchflag*sigma 
+toxmisp_lvt=d*geo_fac*toxp_5_lvt*fac1 
+dxlmisp_lvt=b*geo_fac*lef*fac2 
+dxwmisp_lvt=-b*geo_fac*wef*fac3 
+dvthmisp_lvt=a*geo_fac*fac4 
+fu0misp_lvt=min(e_limit,1+e*geo_fac*fac5)

inline subckt nanch_biso_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) 
parameters l=1u w=1u multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 sigma=1 dmcg=2.05e-007 dmci=3.15e-007 
+ xw=0 + dxwn_na ad=(nf * dmcg + dmci) / factor * (w / nf + xw / factor) as=(nf 
+ * dmcg + dmci) / factor * (w / nf + xw / factor) pd=2 * (nf * dmcg + dmci) / factor 
+ + (nf + 1) * (w / nf + xw / factor) ps=2 * (nf * dmcg + dmci) / factor + (nf + 
+ 1) * (w / nf + xw / factor) nrd=dmcg / factor / nf / (w / nf + xw / factor) nrs=dmcg 
+ / factor / nf / (w / nf + xw / factor) sa=0 / factor sb=0 / factor sd=2 * dmcg 
+ / factor sca=0e-6 / factor scb=0e-6 / factor scc=0e-6 / factor mismatchflag=mismatchflag_mos_na 
+ lef=(l) * factor wef=(w / nf) * factor temp1=par1n_na temp2=par2n_na temp3=par3n_na 
+ temp4=par4n_na temp5=par5n_na mis_a_1=0.0052 mis_a_2=0.43 mis_a_3=0.03173 mis_b_1=0 
+ mis_b_2=0 mis_b_3=0 mis_c_1=1 mis_c_2=0 mis_c_3=0 mis_d_1=0.007 mis_d_2=0.3 mis_d_3=0.3 
+ mis_e_1=0.008 mis_e_2=0.5 mis_e_3=0 e_limit=2 a=mis_a_1 * pow(lef * 1e6,mis_a_2) 
+ * pow(wef * 1e6,mis_a_3) b=mis_b_1 * pow(lef * 1e6,mis_b_2) * pow(wef * 1e6,mis_b_3) 
+ c=mis_c_1 * pow(lef * 1e6,mis_c_2) * pow(wef * 1e6,mis_c_3) d=mis_d_1 * pow(lef 
+ * 1e6,mis_d_2) * pow(wef * 1e6,mis_d_3) e=mis_e_1 * pow(lef * 1e6,mis_e_2) * pow(wef 
+ * 1e6,mis_e_3) fac1=temp1 fac2=temp2 fac3=temp3 fac4=temp4 fac5=c * temp4 + sqrt(1 
+ - c * c) * temp5 geo_fac=1 / sqrt(multi * nf * lef * wef * 1e12) * mismatchflag 
+ * sigma toxmisn_na=d * geo_fac * toxn_na * fac1 dxlmisn_na=b * geo_fac * lef * 
+ fac2 dxwmisn_na= - b * geo_fac * wef * fac3 dvthmisn_na=a * geo_fac * fac4 fu0misn_na=min(e_limit,1 
+ + e * geo_fac * fac5)

section mos_5vna

//        Macro   model            *

inline subckt nanch5_biso_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 sigma=1
+dmcg=2e-007 dmci=2e-007 xw=1e-08+dxwn_5vna
+ad=(nf*dmcg+dmci)/factor*(w/nf+xw/factor) as=(nf*dmcg+dmci)/factor*(w/nf+xw/factor)
+pd=2*(nf*dmcg+dmci)/factor+(nf+1)*(w/nf+xw/factor) ps=2*(nf*dmcg+dmci)/factor+(nf+1)*(w/nf+xw/factor)
+nrd=dmcg/factor/nf/(w/nf+xw/factor) nrs=dmcg/factor/nf/(w/nf+xw/factor)
+sa=0/factor sb=0/factor sd=2*dmcg/factor sca=0e-6/factor scb=0e-6/factor scc=0e-6/factor
+mismatchflag=mismatchflag_mos_5vna
nanch5_biso_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) nanch5_biso w=w  l=l  ad=ad  as=as  pd=pd  ps=ps 
+  nrd=nrd  nrs=nrs  m=multi  nf=nf  sa=sa  sb=sb  sd=sd  sca=sca  scb=scb  scc=scc
//**** mismatch ***
parameters
+lef=(l)*factor 
+wef=(w/nf)*factor 
+temp1=par1n_5vna  temp2=par2n_5vna  temp3=par3n_5vna  temp4=par4n_5vna  temp5=par5n_5vna 

+mis_a_1=0.0022  mis_a_2=-0.0789  mis_a_3=0.031 
+mis_b_1=0       mis_b_2=0   mis_b_3=0 
+mis_c_1=1       mis_c_2=0        mis_c_3=0 
+mis_d_1=0       mis_d_2=0   mis_d_3=0 
+mis_e_1=0.005   mis_e_2=0.1102   mis_e_3=0.0409  e_limit=2
+mis_f_1=0.033   mis_f_2=0   mis_f_3=0 

+a=mis_a_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_a_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_a_3) 
+b=mis_b_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_b_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_b_3) 
+c=mis_c_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_c_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_c_3) 
+d=mis_d_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_d_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_d_3) 
+e=mis_e_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_e_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_e_3) 
+f=mis_f_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_f_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_f_3) 

+fac1=temp1 
+fac2=temp2 
+fac3=temp3 
+fac4=temp4 
+fac5=c*temp4+sqrt(1-c*c)*temp5 

+geo_fac=1/sqrt(multi*nf*lef*wef*1e12)*mismatchflag*sigma 
+toxmisn_5vna=d*geo_fac*toxn_5vna*fac1 
+dxlmisn_5vna=b*geo_fac*lef*fac2 
+dxwmisn_5vna=-b*geo_fac*wef*fac3 
+dvthmisn_5vna=a*geo_fac*fac4 
+fu0misn_5vna=min(e_limit,1+e*geo_fac*fac5) 
+dminvmisn_5vna=f*geo_fac*fac4

section mos_5_switch_hv

//*******************************************************************************************
//*                                                                                         *
//*                mos 0.18um bcd gen2 switch 5v slit nmos device models                     *
//*                                                                                         *
//*******************************************************************************************


inline subckt nch_5_switch_mac ( n1 n2 bs ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor-(int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*(0.54u/factor*((nf-2)/2)+(0.5u/factor)*2)
+ ps=(wef/factor-(int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*(nf+2)+((int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))+1)*2*(0.54u/factor*((nf-2)/2)+(0.5u/factor)*2)
+ ad=(nf)*((0.54u/2)/factor*(wef/factor))
+ pd=(nf*(0.54u/factor+wef/factor))
+ sa=0.5e-06/factor sb=0.5e-06/factor sd=0.54e-06/factor

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters ps1=ps+((int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*nf

parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=0 
//*sh_switch=1
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=0  rd1=0  vdeff=1  vdmr=140 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=0   rdw1=1   rdt1=0   rdt2=0
parameters rdweff=rdw0*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1))*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nch5switch 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=0.02105  wrth0=1.253e-003  k=1.5  rtht1=0  cth=1e-020
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (shflag_5_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (shflag_5_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter  
parameters dgid=1 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub1w0=1e-018  sub1w1=0  sub2=0  sub3=0   sub4=1  ibt1=0  ibt2=0  ic0=1e-3
if (gid_switch==1) {
gid ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=1*(v(n1,bs)<(log(ic0/(1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,bs)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,bs)-(log(ic0/
+ (1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+abs(max(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,bs)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter  
parameters cgb_c1=-5.45e-10  cgb_c2=5.45e-10  cgb_c3=0.1  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=1 
if (cgb_switch==1) {
cgb ( n2 bs ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n2,bs))+cgb_c2*((v(n2,bs))  + (0.5 * (v(n2,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+

inline subckt nch_5_switch_hvnwnbl8_mac ( n1 n2 bs nbl_iso sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1  dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor-(int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*(0.54u/factor*((nf-2)/2)+(0.5u/factor)*2)
+ ps=(wef/factor-(int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*(nf+2)+((int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))+1)*2*(0.54u/factor*((nf-2)/2)+(0.5u/factor)*2)

+ pw_pj=2*(nf*1.14u/factor+(1.18u+0.23u)/factor*2+wef/factor+2*2.16u/factor)

+ nbl_pj=2*(nf*1.14u/factor+(2.42u+1.18u+0.23u)/factor*2+wef/factor+2*4.58u/factor)

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters ps1=ps+((int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*nf

parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=0 
//*sh_switch=1
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=0  rd1=0  vdeff=1  vdmr=140 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=0   rdw1=1   rdt1=0   rdt2=0

//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=0.02105  wrth0=1.253e-003  k=1.5  rtht1=0  cth=1e-020
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (shflag_5_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (shflag_5_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter  
parameters dgid=1 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub

+ abs(max(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,bs)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,bs)-(log(ic0/
+ (1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+abs(max(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,bs)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter  
parameters cgb_c1=-5.45e-10  cgb_c2=5.45e-10  cgb_c3=0.1  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=1

+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nch5switch
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}
//**Combination  
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=max((rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdleff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) +
+  rdc0*wfac_res*(1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0),1e-2)    m=multi*nf

inline subckt nch_5_switch_shpdpwnbl8_mac ( n1 n2 bs nbl_iso sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1  dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor-(int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*(0.54u/factor*((nf-2)/2)+(0.5u/factor)*2)
+ ps=(wef/factor-(int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*(nf+2)+((int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))+1)*2*(0.54u/factor*((nf-2)/2)+(0.5u/factor)*2)
+ ad=(nf)*((0.54u/2)/factor*(wef/factor))
+ pd=(nf*(0.54u/factor+wef/factor))
+ dpw_area=((nf*1.14u/factor)+(3.6u+0.23u)/factor*2)*(wef/factor+2*4.66u/factor)
+ dpw_pj=2*(nf*1.14u/factor+(3.6u+0.23u)/factor*2+wef/factor+2*4.66u/factor)
+ nbl_area=((nf*1.14u/factor)+(3.42u+3.6u+0.23u)/factor*2)*(wef/factor+2*8.08u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(nf*1.14u/factor+(3.42u+3.6u+0.23u)/factor*2+wef/factor+2*8.08u/factor)
+ sa=0.5e-06/factor sb=0.5e-06/factor sd=0.54e-06/factor

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters ps1=ps+((int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*nf
parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=0 
//*sh_switch=1
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=0  rd1=0  vdeff=1  vdmr=140 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=0   rdw1=1   rdt1=0   rdt2=0
parameters rdweff=rdw0*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1))*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nch5switch 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=0.02105  wrth0=1.253e-003  k=1.5  rtht1=0  cth=1e-020
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (shflag_5_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (shflag_5_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter  
parameters dgid=1 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub1w0=1e-018  sub1w1=0  sub2=0  sub3=0   sub4=1  ibt1=0  ibt2=0  ic0=1e-3
if (gid_switch==1) {
gid ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=1*(v(n1,bs)<(log(ic0/(1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,bs)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,bs)-(log(ic0/
+ (1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+abs(max(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,bs)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter  
parameters cgb_c1=-5.45e-10  cgb_c2=5.45e-10  cgb_c3=0.1  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=1 
if (cgb_switch==1) {
cgb ( n2 bs ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n2,bs))+cgb_c2*((v(n2,bs))  + (0.5 * (v(n2,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nch5switch
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}
//**Combination  
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=max((rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdleff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) +
+  rdc0*wfac_res*(1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0),1e-2)    m=multi*nf
parameters cjswdn_nch5switch_din=(cjswdn_nch5switch*(pd-w))/pd 
parameters jswdn_nch5switch_din=(1.32e-013*(pd-w)+1.33e-013*w)/pd 
//*main n11 n2 bs bs nch_5_switch  w=w l=l m=multi nf=nf  as=as ad=ad ps=ps pd=pd
nch_5_switch_shpdpwnbl8_mac ( n11 n2 bs bs ) nch_5_switch  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf   as=as  ad=ad  ps=ps1  pd=pd  sa=sa  sb=sb  sd=sd
//**** parasitic c for soa check

inline subckt pch_5_switch_slit_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1  dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor-(int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*(0.54u/factor*((nf-2)/2)+(0.48u/factor)*2)
+ ps=(wef/factor-(int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*(nf+2)+((int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))+1)*2*(0.54u/factor*((nf-2)/2)+(0.48u/factor)*2)
+ ad=(nf)*((0.54u/2)/factor*(wef/factor))
+ pd=(nf*(0.54u/factor+wef/factor))
+ nw_area=((nf*1.04u/factor)+(1.04u+0.21u)/factor*2)*(wef/factor+2*2.11u/factor)
+ nw_pj=2*(nf*1.04u/factor+(1.04u+0.21u)/factor*2+wef/factor+2*2.11u/factor)
+ sa=0.48e-06/factor sb=0.48e-06/factor sd=0.54e-06/factor
parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters ps1=ps+((int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*nf

parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=0 
//*sh_switch=1
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=300  rd1=0  vdeff=1.5  vdmr=62 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=1.636e-6   rdw1=-1.2322   rdt1=-0.006   rdt2=0e-005
parameters rdweff=rdw0*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1))*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdp_pch5switchslit 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=2.392e-2  wrth0=5.622e-4  k=1.5  rtht1=0  cth=1e-20
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (shflag_5_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (shflag_5_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter  
parameters dgid=1+dgidp_pch5switchslit 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub1w0=1e-018  sub1w1=0  sub2=0  sub3=0   sub4=1  ibt1=0  ibt2=0  ic0=1e-3
if (gid_switch==1) {
gid ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=-1*(v(bs,n1)<(log(ic0/(sub1weff*pwr((1e-3+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-3+
+ abs(min(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-3+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-3+
+ abs(min(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(bs,n1)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(bs,n1)-(log(ic0/
+ (sub1weff*pwr((1e-3+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-3+abs(min(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(bs,n1)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter  
parameters cgb_c1=-5e-010  cgb_c2=5e-010  cgb_c3=5.6285  cgb_c4=0.15  cgb_c5=1.0538 
if (cgb_switch==1) {
cgb ( n2 bs ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(bs,n2))+cgb_c2*((v(bs,n2))  - (0.5 * (v(bs,n2)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(bs,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(bs,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ - (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(bs,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(bs,n2)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(bs,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbp_pch5switchslit
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}
//**ESOA 
parameters  soac1=1.00e-37   soac2=9.956   soac3=0.086   soac4=0.000   soac5=1.000   soaic0=0.1001 
if (esoaflag_5_switch==1) {
gsoa ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=-1*(v(bs,n1)  < ((log(soaic0/soac1)+(soac3*min(v(n2,bs),0)*min(v(n2,bs),0)+
+ soac4*min(v(n2,bs),0)+soac5))/soac2) ? (soac1*exp(soac2*v(bs,n1)-(soac3*min(v(n2,bs),0)*min(v(n2,bs),0)+
+ soac4*min(v(n2,bs),0)+soac5))) : soaic0 + (soac2*soaic0) * (v(bs,n1) - ((log(soaic0/
+ soac1)+(soac3*min(v(n2,bs),0)*min(v(n2,bs),0)+soac4*min(v(n2,bs),0)+soac5))/soac2))) 
+  m=multi*nf 
} else if (esoaflag_5_switch==0) {
}
//**Combination  
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=max(((rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)<0)?1:0) + rdc0*wfac_res*(1-
+ (v(n1,bs)<0)?1:0)),1e-2)    m=multi*nf
parameters cjswdp_pch5switchslit_din=(cjswdp_pch5switchslit*(pd-w))/pd 
parameters jswdp_pch5switchslit_din=(7.030000e-14*(pd-w)+8.100000e-14*w)/pd 
//*main n11 n2 bs bs pch_5_switch_slit  w=w l=l m=multi nf=nf  as=as ad=ad ps=ps pd=pd
pch_5_switch_slit_mac ( n11 n2 bs bs ) pch_5_switch_slit  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf   as=as  ad=ad  ps=ps1  pd=pd  sa=sa  sb=sb  sd=sd
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=5.5*(max(ov_ratio_5_switch/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 bs ) capacitor      c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=5.5*(max(ov_ratio_5_switch/1.1,1))

if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub bs ) nwdio_5_iso area=nw_area  pj=nw_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {

}

section mos_5_low_ron_switch_hv

//*******************************************************************************************
//*                                                                                         *
//*                mos 0.18um bcd gen2 low ron switch 5v slit nmos device models            *
//*                                                                                         *
//*******************************************************************************************


inline subckt nch_5_switch_low_ron_mac ( n1 n2 bs ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+as=(wef/factor-(int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*(0.54u/factor*((nf-2)/2)+(0.5u/factor)*2)
+ps=(wef/factor-(int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*(nf+2)+((int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))+1)*2*(0.54u/factor*((nf-2)/2)+(0.5u/factor)*2)
+ad=(nf/2)*(0.54u/factor*(wef/factor))
+pd=(nf*(0.54u/factor+wef/factor))
+sa=0.5e-06/factor sb=0.5e-06/factor sd=0.54e-06/factor
parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters ps1=ps+((int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*nf

parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=0  sh_switch=1 
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=0  rd1=0  vdeff=1  vdmr=140 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=0   rdw1=1   rdt1=0   rdt2=0
parameters rdweff=rdw0*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1))*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nch5switchlowron 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=0.02105  wrth0=1.253e-003  k=1.5  rtht1=0  cth=1e-020
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (shflag_5_low_ron_switch*sh_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (shflag_5_low_ron_switch*sh_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter  
parameters dgid=1 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub1w0=1e-018  sub1w1=0  sub2=0  sub3=0   sub4=1  ibt1=0  ibt2=0  ic0=1e-3
if (gid_switch==1) {
gid ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=1*(v(n1,bs)<(log(ic0/(1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,bs)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,bs)-(log(ic0/
+ (1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+abs(max(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,bs)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter  
parameters cgb_c1=-5.45e-10  cgb_c2=5.45e-10  cgb_c3=0.1  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=1 
if (cgb_switch==1) {
cgb ( n2 bs ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n2,bs))+cgb_c2*((v(n2,bs))  + (0.5 * (v(n2,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nch5switchlowron
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}
//**Combination  
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=max((rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdleff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) +
+  rdc0*wfac_res*(1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0),1e-2)    m=multi*nf
parameters cjswdn_nch5switchlowron_din=(cjswdn_nch5switchlowron*(pd-w))/pd 
parameters jswdn_nch5switchlowron_din=(1.32e-013*(pd-w)+1.33e-013*w)/pd 
parameters  soac1=1.00e-35   soac2=8.37  soac3=-2.35   soac4=1   soaic0=0.0191 
if (esoaflag_5_low_ron_switch==1) {
gsoa ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(v(n1,bs)  < ((log(soaic0/soac1)+(soac3*v(n2,bs)+soac4))/
+ soac2) ? (soac1*exp(soac2*v(n1,bs)-(soac3*v(n2,bs)+soac4))) : soaic0 + (soac2*soaic0) 
+ * (v(n1,bs) - ((log(soaic0/soac1)+(soac3*v(n2,bs)+soac4))/soac2)))  m=multi*nf 
} else if (esoaflag_5_low_ron_switch==0) {
}
//*main n11 n2 bs bs nch_5_switch_low_ron  w=w l=l m=multi nf=nf  as=as ad=ad ps=ps pd=pd  
nch_5_switch_low_ron_mac ( n11 n2 bs bs ) nch_5_switch_low_ron  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf   as=as  ad=ad  ps=ps1  pd=pd  sa=sa  sb=sb  sd=sd
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=5.5*(max(ov_ratio_5_low_ron_switch/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 bs ) capacitor      c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=5.5*(max(ov_ratio_5_low_ron_switch/1.1,1))


d_din ( bs n1 ) nch_5_switch_low_ron_din area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi
d_din_g ( bs n1 ) nch_5_switch_low_ron_din_g area=ad  pj=w  m=multi

1: type=n
+lmin=5.500000e-007

inline subckt nch_5_switch_low_ron_hvnwnbl8_mac ( n1 n2 bs nbl_iso sub )

+ as=(wef/factor-(int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*(0.54u/factor*((nf-2)/2)+(0.5u/factor)*2)

parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef

//**rd ldep parameter

parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0

} else if (shflag_5_low_ron_switch*sh_switch==0) {

//**Gid parameter

} else if (cgb_switch==0) {

inline subckt pch_5_switch_low_ron_slit_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub )

+ as=(wef/factor-(int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*(0.54u/factor*((nf-2)/2)+(0.48u/factor)*2)
+ ps=(wef/factor-(int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*(nf+2)+((int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))+1)*2*(0.54u/factor*((nf-2)/2)+(0.48u/factor)*2)

parameters ps1=ps+((int((wef)/(0.47u+1.41u)))*0.47u/factor)*nf

parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef

parameters rd0=300  rd1=0  vdeff=1.5  vdmr=62

if (shflag_5_low_ron_switch==1) {

} else if (shflag_5_low_ron_switch==0) {

//**Gid parameter

+ abs(min(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(bs,n1)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(bs,n1)-(log(ic0/
+ (sub1weff*pwr((1e-3+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-3+abs(min(v(n2,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(bs,n1)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter

+ cgb_c4)*(v(bs,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbp_pch5switchlowronslit
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {

//*******************************************************************************************
//*                                                                                         *
//*                MOS 0.18UM BCD GEN2 Low Ron switch 5V PMOS DEVICE MODELS                 *

//*******************************************************************************************
inline subckt pch_5_switch_low_ron_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(((nf-2)/2)*(0.54u/factor)+(2*0.48u/factor))*(wef/factor)
+ ps=((nf-2)*(0.54u/factor)+(4*0.48u/factor))+((wef/factor)*(nf+2))
+ ad=0.54u/factor*wef/factor*nf/2
+ pd=(0.54u/factor+wef/factor)*2*nf/2
+ nw_area=(((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor)))*(wef/factor+2*1.04u/factor)
+ nw_pj=2*((((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor)))+(wef/factor+2*1.04u/factor))
+ sa=0.48e-06/factor sb=0.48e-06/factor sd=0.54e-6/factor

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 

//*parameters dcg=1.10e-010*w*multi*factor 
//*parameters vgnorm=0.50 
//*parameters dvgs_c2=0  dvgs_c1=0  dvgs_c0=1.38
//*parameters cmin=1e-20 
//*cg1 ( n2 n4 ) bsource c=(cmin+(dcg*(1+tanh((v(n2,n4)-(dvgs_c2*v(n1,n4)*v(n1,n4)+dvgs_c1*v(n1,n4)+dvgs_c0))/vgnorm))))*cgbp_pch5switchlowron

//**** cgb ****
parameters cgb_c1=-2.5e-010  cgb_c2=2.5e-010  cgb_c3=0.1  cgb_c4=0.04  cgb_c5=1.2 
cgb ( n2 n4 ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n4,n2))+cgb_c2*((v(n4,n2))  - (0.5 * (v(n4,n2)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ - (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbp_pch5switchlowron


//*** e-soa ***
parameters  soac1=1.00e-35   soac2=8.740   soac3=0.090   soac4=0.000   soac5=1.000   soaic0=0.0280 
if (esoaflag_5_low_ron_switch==1) {
gsoa ( n1 n3 ) bsource  i=-1*(v(n3,n1)  < ((log(soaic0/(soac1+1e-30))+(soac3*min(v(n2,n3),0)*min(v(n2,n3),0)+
+ soac4*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac5))/soac2) ? (soac1*exp(soac2*v(n3,n1)-(soac3*min(v(n2,n3),0)*min(v(n2,n3),0)+
+ soac4*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac5))) : soaic0 + (soac2*soaic0) * (v(n3,n1) - ((log(soaic0/
+ (soac1+1e-30))+(soac3*min(v(n2,n3),0)*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac4*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac5))/
+ soac2)))  m=multi*nf 
} else if (esoaflag_5_low_ron_switch==0) {
}


parameters cjswp_pch5switchlowron_din=(cjswp_pch5switchlowron*(pd-w))/pd 
parameters cjswp_pch5switchlowron_s=(cjswp_pch5switchlowron*(ps-w))/ps 

parameters jswp_pch5switchlowron_din=(7.03e-14*(pd-w)+8.1e-14*w)/pd 
parameters jswp_pch5switchlowron_s=(7.03e-14*(ps-w)+8.1e-14*w)/ps 

pch_5_switch_low_ron_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) pch_5_switch_low_ron l=l  w=w  m=multi  nf=nf  as=as  ps=ps  ad=ad  pd=pd  sa=sa  sb=sb  sd=sd
cb_sub ( n4 sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=5.5*(max(ov_ratio_5_low_ron_switch/1.1,1))

d_s ( n3 n4 ) pch_5_switch_low_ron_s area=as  pj=ps  m=multi

} else if (dti==1) {

}

inline subckt pch_5_switch_low_ron_hvnwnbl8_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 shp_iso sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(((nf-2)/2)*(0.54u/factor)+(2*0.48u/factor))*(wef/factor)
+ ps=((nf-2)*(0.54u/factor)+(4*0.48u/factor))+((wef/factor)*(nf+2))
+ ad=0.54u/factor*wef/factor*nf/2
+ pd=(0.54u/factor+wef/factor)*2*nf/2
+ nw_area=(((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor)))*(wef/factor+2*2.11u/factor)
+ nw_pj=2*((((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor)))+(wef/factor+2*2.11u/factor))
+ shp_area=(((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor+3.5u/factor)))*(wef/factor+2*5.61u/factor)
+ shp_pj=2*((((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor+3.5u/factor)))+(wef/factor+2*5.61u/factor))
+ nbl_area=(((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor+3.5u/factor+2.42u/factor)))*(wef/factor+2*8.03u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*((((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor+3.5u/factor+2.42u/factor)))+(wef/factor+2*8.03u/factor))
+ sa=0.48e-06/factor sb=0.48e-06/factor sd=0.54e-6/factor

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
//*parameters dcg=1.10e-010*w*multi*factor 
//*parameters vgnorm=0.50 
//*parameters dvgs_c2=0  dvgs_c1=0  dvgs_c0=1.38
//*parameters cmin=1e-20 
//*cg1 ( n2 n4 ) bsource c=(cmin+(dcg*(1+tanh((v(n2,n4)-(dvgs_c2*v(n1,n4)*v(n1,n4)+dvgs_c1*v(n1,n4)+dvgs_c0))/vgnorm))))*cgbp_pch5switchlowron

//**** cgb ****
parameters cgb_c1=-2.5e-010  cgb_c2=2.5e-010  cgb_c3=0.1  cgb_c4=0.04  cgb_c5=1.2 
cgb ( n2 n4 ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n4,n2))+cgb_c2*((v(n4,n2))  - (0.5 * (v(n4,n2)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ - (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbp_pch5switchlowron


//*** e-soa ***
parameters  soac1=1.00e-35   soac2=8.740   soac3=0.090   soac4=0.000   soac5=1.000   soaic0=0.0280 
if (esoaflag_5_low_ron_switch==1) {
gsoa ( n1 n3 ) bsource  i=-1*(v(n3,n1)  < ((log(soaic0/(soac1+1e-30))+(soac3*min(v(n2,n3),0)*min(v(n2,n3),0)+
+ soac4*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac5))/soac2) ? (soac1*exp(soac2*v(n3,n1)-(soac3*min(v(n2,n3),0)*min(v(n2,n3),0)+
+ soac4*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac5))) : soaic0 + (soac2*soaic0) * (v(n3,n1) - ((log(soaic0/
+ (soac1+1e-30))+(soac3*min(v(n2,n3),0)*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac4*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac5))/
+ soac2)))  m=multi*nf 
} else if (esoaflag_5_low_ron_switch==0) {
}

parameters cjswp_pch5switchlowron_s=(cjswp_pch5switchlowron*(ps-w))/ps

inline subckt pch_5_switch_low_ron_shpdpwnbl8_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 dpw_iso nbl_iso sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(((nf-2)/2)*(0.54u/factor)+(2*0.48u/factor))*(wef/factor)
+ ps=((nf-2)*(0.54u/factor)+(4*0.48u/factor))+((wef/factor)*(nf+2))
+ ad=0.54u/factor*wef/factor*nf/2
+ pd=(0.54u/factor+wef/factor)*2*nf/2
+ nw_area=(((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor)))*(wef/factor+2*2.11u/factor)
+ nw_pj=2*((((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor)))+(wef/factor+2*2.11u/factor))
+ dpw_area=(((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor+2.5u/factor)))*(wef/factor+2*4.61u/factor)
+ dpw_pj=2*((((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor+2.5u/factor)))+(wef/factor+2*4.61u/factor))
+ nbl_area=(((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor+2.5u/factor+3.42u/factor)))*(wef/factor+2*8.03u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*((((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor+2.5u/factor+3.42u/factor)))+(wef/factor+2*8.03u/factor))
+ sa=0.48e-06/factor sb=0.48e-06/factor sd=0.54e-6/factor

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 

//*parameters dcg=1.10e-010*w*multi*factor 
//*parameters vgnorm=0.50 
//*parameters dvgs_c2=0  dvgs_c1=0  dvgs_c0=1.38
//*parameters cmin=1e-20 
//*cg1 ( n2 n4 ) bsource c=(cmin+(dcg*(1+tanh((v(n2,n4)-(dvgs_c2*v(n1,n4)*v(n1,n4)+dvgs_c1*v(n1,n4)+dvgs_c0))/vgnorm))))*cgbp_pch5switchlowron

//**** cgb ****

inline subckt pch_5_switch_low_ron_shpdpwnbl29_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 dpw_iso nbl_iso sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(((nf-2)/2)*(0.54u/factor)+(2*0.48u/factor))*(wef/factor)
+ ps=((nf-2)*(0.54u/factor)+(4*0.48u/factor))+((wef/factor)*(nf+2))
+ ad=0.54u/factor*wef/factor*nf/2
+ pd=(0.54u/factor+wef/factor)*2*nf/2
+ nw_area=(((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor)))*(wef/factor+2*2.11u/factor)
+ nw_pj=2*((((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor)))+(wef/factor+2*2.11u/factor))
+ dpw_area=(((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor+2.5u/factor)))*(wef/factor+2*4.61u/factor)
+ dpw_pj=2*((((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor+2.5u/factor)))+(wef/factor+2*4.61u/factor))
+ nbl_area=(((nf-1)*0.54u/factor)+(nf*l)+(2*(0.48u/factor+1.04u/factor+2.5u/factor+4u/factor)))*(wef/factor+2*8.61u/factor)

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 

//*parameters dcg=1.10e-010*w*multi*factor 
//*parameters vgnorm=0.50

//*parameters cmin=1e-20 
//*cg1 ( n2 n4 ) bsource c=(cmin+(dcg*(1+tanh((v(n2,n4)-(dvgs_c2*v(n1,n4)*v(n1,n4)+dvgs_c1*v(n1,n4)+dvgs_c0))/vgnorm))))*cgbp_pch5switchlowron

//**** cgb ****

+ - (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbp_pch5switchlowron

//*** e-soa ***

+ soac4*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac5))) : soaic0 + (soac2*soaic0) * (v(n3,n1) - ((log(soaic0/
+ (soac1+1e-30))+(soac3*min(v(n2,n3),0)*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac4*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac5))/
+ soac2)))  m=multi*nf 
} else if (esoaflag_5_low_ron_switch==0) {
}

+ as=(((nf-2)/2)*(0.54u/factor)+(2*0.48u/factor))*(wef/factor)

+ cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbp_pch5switchlowron

+ (soac1+1e-30))+(soac3*min(v(n2,n3),0)*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac4*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac5))/

} else if (esoaflag_5_low_ron_switch==0) {
}

+ as=(((nf-2)/2)*(0.54u/factor)+(2*0.48u/factor))*(wef/factor)

+ cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbp_pch5switchlowron

+ (soac1+1e-30))+(soac3*min(v(n2,n3),0)*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac4*min(v(n2,n3),0)+soac5))/

} else if (esoaflag_5_low_ron_switch==0) {
}

//*******************************************************************************************
//*                                                                                         *
//*            MOS 0.18UM BCD GEN2 Low Ron switch NSW50BVG5B(GB) DEVICE MODELS               *
//*                                                                                         *
//*******************************************************************************************  
inline subckt nsw50bv_g5b_low_ron_mac ( n1 n2 bs ) 
parameters  l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*3.63u/factor+bb*2.71u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*3.63u/factor+bb*2.71u/factor)+(nf+bb)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=1  sh_switch=1 
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=8.8222e+3 
parameters rd1=-0.0276 
parameters vdeff=1.1812 
parameters vdmr=167 
parameters rdb0=0 
parameters rdw0=3.74e-5 
parameters rdw1=-0.943 
parameters rdt1=1.68e-3 
parameters rdt2=0 
parameters rdweff=rdw0*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1))*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nsw50bvg5blowron 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=1.22450e-3  wrth0=5.52e-6  k=1.4  rtht1=7e-3  cth=1e-20
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (sh_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (sh_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter
parameters dgid=1 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub1w0=2.8672e-014  sub1w1=3.7749e-019  sub2=2.9979  sub3=4.9235   sub4=0.076187  ibt1=-0.0050884  ibt2=-1.3075e-019  ic0=0.00099953

if (gid_switch==1) {
gid ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=1*(v(n1,bs)<(log(ic0/(1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,bs)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,bs)-(log(ic0/
+ (1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,bs)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter

parameters cgb_c1=-1.98e-9  cgb_c2=1.98e-9  cgb_c3=0.01  cgb_c4=0.03  cgb_c5=1 

if (cgb_switch==1) {
cgb ( n21 bs ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n21,bs))+cgb_c2*((v(n21,bs))  + (0.5 * (v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nsw50bvg5blowron
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}
parameters evg_type=1 
parameters evg_peak=7.5 
parameters evg_delta=0.01 
evg ( n21 n2 ) bsource  v=0.5  * (  (1.0e-3+(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs)+evg_type 
+ *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  - evg_type *sqrt( (1.0e-3-(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+
+ v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta))))) * (1.0e-3-(evg_peak -
+  (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  +  evg_delta 
+ ) )
//**combination
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=max((rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n21,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdleff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) +
+  rdc0*wfac_res*(1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0),1e-2)    m=multi*nf
nsw50bv_g5b_low_ron_mac ( n11 n21 bs bs ) nsw50bv_g5b_low_ron  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf

//***** 1/f noise multi modification for fnoimod=0
parameters kf1=1e-28 
parameters af1=0.6 
parameters kffac=kf1*(pwr(abs(nf),(1-af1))) 

//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=50*(max(ov_ratio_hv_low_ron_switch/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 bs ) capacitor      c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=50*(max(ov_ratio_hv_low_ron_switch/1.1,1))

//*******esoa***************
if (esoaflag_hv_low_ron_switch==1) {
parameters  soac1=1.00e-35   soac2=1.163   soac3=-0.390   soac4=0.000   soac5=1.000   soaic0=0.0267 
gsoa ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(v(n1,bs)  < ((log(soaic0/soac1)+(soac3*max(v(n21,bs),0)*max(v(n21,bs),0)+
+ soac4*max(v(n21,bs),0)+soac5))/soac2) ? (soac1*exp(soac2*v(n1,bs)-(soac3*max(v(n21,bs),0)*max(v(n21,bs),0)+
+ soac4*max(v(n21,bs),0)+soac5))) : soaic0 + (soac2*soaic0) * (v(n1,bs) - ((log(soaic0/
+ soac1)+(soac3*max(v(n21,bs),0)*max(v(n21,bs),0)+soac4*max(v(n21,bs),0)+soac5))/soac2))) 
+  m=multi*nf 
} else if (esoaflag_hv_low_ron_switch==0) {
}
d_din ( bs n1 ) nsw50bv_g5b_low_ron_din area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi
parameters cjswdn_nsw50bvg5blowron_din=(cjswdn_nsw50bvg5blowron*(pd-w)+cjswgdn_nsw50bvg5blowron*w)/pd 
parameters jswdn_nsw50bvg5blowron_din=(2.500e-12*(pd-w)+2.500e-12*w)/pd

section mos_5_fgd

//**********************************
//*       macro   model            *

inline subckt nch_5_ngd_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 factor=1 sigma=1

+dmcg=2e-007 dmci=2e-007 xw=1e-08+dxwn_nch5ngd
+ad=(1*dmcg+dmci)/factor*(w/1+xw/factor) as=(1*dmcg+dmci)/factor*(w/1+xw/factor)
+pd=2*(1*dmcg+dmci)/factor+(1+1)*(w/1+xw/factor) ps=2*(1*dmcg+dmci)/factor+(1+1)*(w/1+xw/factor)
+nrd=dmcg/factor/1/(w/1+xw/factor) nrs=dmcg/factor/1/(w/1+xw/factor)
+mismatchflag=mismatchflag_mos_5_fgd

//**cgb parameter
parameters cgb_c1=-0.7e-09  cgb_c2=0.7e-09  cgb_c3=0.55  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=1.05 

cgb ( n2 n4 ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n2,n4))+cgb_c2*((v(n2,n4))  + (0.5 * (v(n2,n4)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nch5ngd

//**combination
parameters delta_t=temp  - 25

parameters ktt1_10=-0.318 
parameters ktt2_10=-2.5e-4

parameters wef=(w/1)*factor

+temp1=par1n_nch5ngd  temp2=par2n_nch5ngd  temp3=par3n_nch5ngd  temp4=par4n_nch5ngd  temp5=par5n_nch5ngd

+dxwmis_nch5ngd=-b*geo_fac*wef*fac3

//**********************************
//*       Macro   model            *
//**********************************
inline subckt nch_5_fgd_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 factor=1 sigma=1

+dmcg=2e-007 dmci=2e-007 xw=1e-08+dxwn_nch5fgd
+ad=(1*dmcg+dmci)/factor*(w/1+xw/factor) as=(1*dmcg+dmci)/factor*(w/1+xw/factor)
+pd=2*(1*dmcg+dmci)/factor+(1+1)*(w/1+xw/factor) ps=2*(1*dmcg+dmci)/factor+(1+1)*(w/1+xw/factor)
+nrd=dmcg/factor/1/(w/1+xw/factor) nrs=dmcg/factor/1/(w/1+xw/factor)
+mismatchflag=mismatchflag_mos_5_fgd

//**cgb parameter
parameters cgb_c1=-0.6e-09  cgb_c2=0.6e-09  cgb_c3=0.75  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=0.06 

cgb ( n2 n4 ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n2,n4))+cgb_c2*((v(n2,n4))  + (0.5 * (v(n2,n4)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nch5fgd

//**combination
parameters delta_t=temp  - 25

parameters ktt1_10=-0.52 
parameters ktt2_10=-3.7e-4 
parameters ktfac_10=ktt1_10  + ktt2_10 * delta_t + ktfacn_nch5fgd
parameters citt1_10=0.00066 
parameters citt2_10=0.0000023 
parameters citfac_10=citt1_10  + citt2_10 * delta_t

parameters ktt1_15=-0.513 
parameters ktt2_15=-3.6e-4 
parameters ktfac_15=ktt1_15  + ktt2_15 * delta_t + ktfacn_nch5fgd
parameters citt1_15=0.00062 
parameters citt2_15=0.0000019 
parameters citfac_15=citt1_15  + citt2_15 * delta_t

parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters wef=(w/1)*factor 

//**** mismatch ***
parameters
+temp1=par1n_nch5fgd  temp2=par2n_nch5fgd  temp3=par3n_nch5fgd  temp4=par4n_nch5fgd  temp5=par5n_nch5fgd 

+mis_a_1=0.003  mis_a_2=0.3  mis_a_3=0 
+mis_b_1=0.0054  mis_b_2=0  mis_b_3=0 
+mis_c_1=1  mis_c_2=0  mis_c_3=0 
+mis_d_1=1e-4  mis_d_2=0  mis_d_3=0 
+mis_e_1=0.002  mis_e_2=0  mis_e_3=0  e_limit=2
+mis_f_1=0  mis_f_2=0  mis_f_3=0 

+a=mis_a_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_a_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_a_3) 
+b=mis_b_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_b_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_b_3) 
+c=mis_c_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_c_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_c_3) 
+d=mis_d_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_d_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_d_3) 
+e=mis_e_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_e_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_e_3) 
+f=mis_f_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_f_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_f_3) 

+fac1=temp1 
+fac2=temp2 
+fac3=temp3 
+fac4=temp4 
+fac5=c*temp4+sqrt(1-c*c)*temp5 

+geo_fac=1/sqrt(multi*1*lef*wef*1e12)*mismatchflag*sigma 
+toxmis_nch5fgd=d*geo_fac*toxn_nch5fgd*fac1 
+dxlmis_nch5fgd=b*geo_fac*lef*fac2 
+dxwmis_nch5fgd=-b*geo_fac*wef*fac3 
+dvthmis_nch5fgd=a*geo_fac*fac4 
+fu0mis_nch5fgd=min(e_limit,1+e*geo_fac*fac5) 
+dminvmis_nch5fgd=f*geo_fac*fac4 

nch_5_fgd_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) nch_5_fgd w=w  l=l  ad=ad  as=as  pd=pd  ps=ps  nrd=nrd  nrs=nrs  m=multi

//**********************************
//*       Macro   model            *
//**********************************
inline subckt pch_5_ngd_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 factor=1 sigma=1

+dmcg=2e-007 dmci=2e-007 xw=1e-08+dxwp_pch5ngd
+ad=(1*dmcg+dmci)/factor*(w/1+xw/factor) as=(1*dmcg+dmci)/factor*(w/1+xw/factor)
+pd=2*(1*dmcg+dmci)/factor+(1+1)*(w/1+xw/factor) ps=2*(1*dmcg+dmci)/factor+(1+1)*(w/1+xw/factor)
+nrd=dmcg/factor/1/(w/1+xw/factor) nrs=dmcg/factor/1/(w/1+xw/factor)
+mismatchflag=mismatchflag_mos_5_fgd

//**cgb macro
parameters cgb_c1=-4.3e-10  cgb_c2=4.3e-10  cgb_c3=0.9  cgb_c4=0.2  cgb_c5=1.176 

cgb ( n2 n4 ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n4,n2))+cgb_c2*((v(n4,n2))  - (0.5 * (v(n4,n2)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ - (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbp_pch5ngd

//**combination
parameters delta_t=temp  - 25

parameters ktt1_10=-0.315 
parameters ktt2_10=-1.5e-4 
parameters ktfac_10=ktt1_10  + ktt2_10 * delta_t+ktfacp_pch5ngd
parameters citt1_10=0.00062 
parameters citt2_10=0.0000024 
parameters citfac_10=citt1_10  + citt2_10 * delta_t

parameters ktt1_15=-0.314 
parameters ktt2_15=-1.5e-4 
parameters ktfac_15=ktt1_15  + ktt2_15 * delta_t+ktfacp_pch5ngd
parameters citt1_15=0.00058 
parameters citt2_15=0.0000029 
parameters citfac_15=citt1_15  + citt2_15 * delta_t

parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters wef=(w/1)*factor 

//**** mismatch ***
parameters
+temp1=par1p_pch5ngd  temp2=par2p_pch5ngd  temp3=par3p_pch5ngd  temp4=par4p_pch5ngd  temp5=par5p_pch5ngd 

+mis_a_1=-0.00205  mis_a_2=0.2  mis_a_3=0.2 
+mis_b_1=0.0045  mis_b_2=0  mis_b_3=0 
+mis_c_1=1  mis_c_2=0  mis_c_3=0 
+mis_d_1=1e-04  mis_d_2=0  mis_d_3=0 
+mis_e_1=0.002  mis_e_2=0  mis_e_3=0  e_limit=2
+mis_f_1=0.001  mis_f_2=0.7  mis_f_3=0.7 

+a=mis_a_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_a_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_a_3) 
+b=mis_b_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_b_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_b_3) 
+c=mis_c_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_c_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_c_3) 
+d=mis_d_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_d_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_d_3) 
+e=mis_e_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_e_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_e_3) 
+f=mis_f_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_f_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_f_3) 

+fac1=temp1 
+fac2=temp2 
+fac3=temp3 
+fac4=temp4 
+fac5=c*temp4+sqrt(1-c*c)*temp5 

+geo_fac=1/sqrt(multi*1*lef*wef*1e12)*mismatchflag*sigma 
+toxmis_pch5ngd=d*geo_fac*toxp_pch5ngd*fac1 
+dxlmis_pch5ngd=b*geo_fac*lef*fac2 
+dxwmis_pch5ngd=-b*geo_fac*wef*fac3 
+dvthmis_pch5ngd=a*geo_fac*fac4 
+fu0mis_pch5ngd=min(e_limit,1+e*geo_fac*fac5) 
+dminvmis_pch5ngd=f*geo_fac*fac4 

pch_5_ngd_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) pch_5_ngd w=w  l=l  ad=ad  as=as  pd=pd  ps=ps  nrd=nrd  nrs=nrs  m=multi

+dmcg=2e-007 dmci=2e-007 xw=1e-08+dxwp_pch5fgd

parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf

inline subckt nld6_g5a_de_iso_mac ( n1 n2 bs nbl_iso sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_hv sigma=1
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*(0.7u+0.63u)/factor+bb*1.21u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*(0.7u+0.63u)/factor+bb*1.21u/factor)+(nf+bb)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor)
+ dpw_area=(aa*0u/factor+nf*(l+(0.54u+0.63u)/factor)+bb*(1.21u+2.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3.42u/factor)
+ dpw_pj=2*(aa*0u/factor+nf*(l+(0.54u+0.63u)/factor)+bb*(1.21u+2.42u)/factor+wef/factor+2*3.42u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(aa*(2.42u+0u)/factor+nf*(l+(0.54u+0.63u)/factor)+bb*(1.21u+2.42u+2.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*5.84u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(aa*(2.42u+0u)/factor+nf*(l+(0.54u+0.63u)/factor)+bb*(1.21u+2.42u+2.42u)/factor+wef/factor+2*5.84u/factor)
+area_total=(0*(2.42u+0u)/factor+nf*(l+(0.54u+0.63u)/factor)+2*(1.21u+2.42u+2.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*5.84u/factor)
parameters area_nf=area_total-(0*(2.42u+0u)/factor+2*(1.21u+2.42u+2.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*5.84u/factor) 
parameters area_unit=(1*(l+(0.54u+0.63u)/factor))*(wef/factor+2*5.84u/factor) 
parameters fn_total=(area_nf/area_unit) 
parameters ad_total=(fn_total*(0.7u+0.63u)/factor+2*1.21u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor) 
parameters dpw_area_dc=(0*0u/factor+fn_total*(l+(0.54u+0.63u)/factor)+2*(1.21u+2.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3.42u/factor) 
parameters dpw_pj_dc=2*(0*0u/factor+fn_total*(l+(0.54u+0.63u)/factor)+2*(1.21u+2.42u)/factor+wef/factor+2*3.42u/factor) 


parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters cjswdn_nld6g5adeiso_din=(cjswdn_nld6g5adeiso*(pd-w))/pd 
parameters jswdn_nld6g5adeiso_din=(3.500e-13*(pd-w)+3.5e-13*w)/pd

+ soac4*max(v(n2,bs),0)+soac5))) : soaic0 + (soac2*soaic0) * (v(n1,bs) - ((log(soaic0/

+temp1=par1n_hv  temp2=par2n_hv  temp3=par3n_hv  temp4=par4n_hv  temp5=par5n_hv

inline subckt nld6_g5a_sa_nbl_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(aa*0.8u/factor+nf*0.54u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ pd=2*(aa*0.8u/factor+nf*0.54u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(aa*(1u+0.8u)/factor+bb*1.71u/factor+nf*(0.54u+0.97u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(aa*(1u+0.8u)/factor+bb*1.71u/factor+nf*(0.54u+0.97u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*2u/factor))

+area_total=(0*(1u+0.8u)/factor+2*1.71u/factor+nf*(0.54u+0.97u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor)
parameters area_nf=area_total-(0*(1u+0.8u)/factor+2*1.71u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor) 
parameters area_unit=(1*(0.54u+0.97u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor) 
parameters fn_total=(area_nf/area_unit) 
parameters ad_total=(0*0.8u/factor+fn_total*0.54u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor) 

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters cjswdn_nld6g5asanbl_din=(cjswdn_nld6g5asanbl*(pd-w))/pd

parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0 sigma=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_hv
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*(0.7u+0.27u)/factor+bb*1.21u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*(0.7u+0.27u)/factor+bb*1.21u/factor)+(nf+bb)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor)
+ dpw_area=(aa*0u/factor+nf*(l+(0.54u+0.27u)/factor)+bb*(1.21u+2.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3.42u/factor)
+ dpw_pj=2*(aa*0u/factor+nf*(l+(0.54u+0.27u)/factor)+bb*(1.21u+2.42u)/factor+wef/factor+2*3.42u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(aa*(2.42u+0u)/factor+nf*(l+(0.54u+0.27u)/factor)+bb*(1.21u+2.42u+2.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*5.84u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(aa*(2.42u+0u)/factor+nf*(l+(0.54u+0.27u)/factor)+bb*(1.21u+2.42u+2.42u)/factor+wef/factor+2*5.84u/factor)
+area_total=(0*(2.42u+0u)/factor+nf*(l+(0.54u+0.27u)/factor)+2*(1.21u+2.42u+2.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*5.84u/factor)
parameters area_nf=area_total-(0*(2.42u+0u)/factor+2*(1.21u+2.42u+2.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*5.84u/factor) 
parameters area_unit=(1*(l+(0.54u+0.27u)/factor))*(wef/factor+2*5.84u/factor) 
parameters fn_total=(area_nf/area_unit) 
parameters ad_total=(fn_total*(0.7u+0.27u)/factor+2*1.21u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor) 
parameters dpw_area_dc=(0*0u/factor+fn_total*(l+(0.54u+0.27u)/factor)+2*(1.21u+2.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3.42u/factor) 
parameters dpw_pj_dc=2*(0*0u/factor+fn_total*(l+(0.54u+0.27u)/factor)+2*(1.21u+2.42u)/factor+wef/factor+2*3.42u/factor) 


parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters cjswdn_nld6g5asaiso_din=(cjswdn_nld6g5asaiso*(pd-w))/pd 
parameters jswdn_nld6g5asaiso_din=(3.500e-13*(pd-w)+3.5e-13*w)/pd

//*                  MOS 0.18UM BCD GEN2 NLD8_G5A_NBL DEVICE MODELS                      *

inline subckt nld8_g5a_nbl_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(aa*0.72u/factor+nf*0.54u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ pd=2*(aa*0.72u/factor+nf*0.54u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(aa*(1u+0.72u)/factor+bb*1.71u/factor+nf*(0.54u+1.63u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(aa*(1u+0.72u)/factor+bb*1.71u/factor+nf*(0.54u+1.63u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*2u/factor))
+ area_total=(0*(1u+0.72u)/factor+2*1.71u/factor+nf*(0.54u+1.63u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor)
parameters area_nf=area_total-(0*(1u+0.72u)/factor+2*1.71u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor) 
parameters area_unit=(1*(0.54u+1.63u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor) 
parameters fn_total=(area_nf/area_unit) 
parameters ad_total=(0*0.72u/factor+fn_total*0.54u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor) 

parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=0  sh_switch=0 
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=380.2  rd1=0  vdeff=1.3  vdmr=8.359  rdw0=9.77e-6   rdw1=0   rdt1=0   rdt2=0
parameters rdb0=0 
parameters rdweff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nld8g5anbl 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=9.99e-4  wrth0=1  k=1  rtht1=0  cth=1e-20
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (shflag_hv*sh_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (shflag_hv*sh_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter
parameters dgidn_nld8g5anbl=0 
parameters dgid=1+dgidn_nld8g5anbl 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend

//*******************************************************************************************
//*                                                                                         *
//*                    MOS 0.18UM BCD GEN2 NLD12_G5A_NBL_DE DEVICE MODELS                   *
//*                                                                                         *
//*******************************************************************************************
inline subckt nld12_g5a_nbl_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(aa*0.8u/factor+nf*0.54u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ pd=2*(aa*0.8u/factor+nf*0.54u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(aa*(1.5u+0.8u)/factor+bb*2.21u/factor+nf*(0.54u+1.83u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(aa*(1.5u+0.8u)/factor+bb*2.21u/factor+nf*(0.54u+1.83u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor))
+ area_total=(0*(1.5u+0.8u)/factor+2*2.21u/factor+nf*(0.54u+1.83u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)
parameters area_nf=area_total-(0*(1.5u+0.8u)/factor+2*2.21u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor) 
parameters area_unit=(1*(0.54u+1.83u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor) 
parameters fn_total=(area_nf/area_unit) 
parameters ad_total=(0*0.8u/factor+fn_total*0.54u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor) 

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters wef_long=20e-6 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_long)?wef:wef_long 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_long)?1:wef_long/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters rdt_eff=(1+  rdt0*delta_t+rdt1*delta_t*delta_t)
parameters drd=1+drdn_nld12g5anbl 
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=480  rd1=0  vdeff=1.3  vdmr=18.75  rdb0=0  rdt0=0.00051  rdt1=0  rdw0=2.2e-5   rdw1=-0.05  rdc0=1
parameters rd_weff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 

r1 ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res+rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rd_weff * rdt_eff *drd) *((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) + rdc0*wfac_res* 
+ (1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0)    m=multi*nf
parameters cjswdn_nld12g5anbl_din=(cjswdn_nld12g5anbl*(pd-w)+cjswgdn_nld12g5anbl*w)/pd 
parameters jswdn_nld12g5anbl_din=(3.200e-13*(pd-w)+3.040e-13*w)/pd 

nld12_g5a_nbl_mac ( n11 n2 bs bs ) nld12_g5a_nbl w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf  ad=ad  as=as  pd=pd  ps=ps
//***** 1/f noise multi modification for fnoimod=0
parameters kf1=2.5e-29 
parameters af1=0.2 
parameters kffac=kf1*(pwr(abs(nf),(1-af1))) 

d_din ( bs n1 ) nld12_g5a_nbl_din area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi

//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=13.2*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 bs ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=13.2*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=13.2*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

inline subckt nld16_g5a_nbl_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(aa*0.8u/factor+nf*0.54u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ pd=2*(aa*0.8u/factor+nf*0.54u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(aa*(2u+0.8u)/factor+bb*2.71u/factor+nf*(0.54u+2.03u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(aa*(2u+0.8u)/factor+bb*2.71u/factor+nf*(0.54u+2.03u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor))
+ area_total=(0*(2u+0.8u)/factor+2*2.71u/factor+nf*(0.54u+2.03u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)
parameters area_nf=area_total-(0*(2u+0.8u)/factor+2*2.71u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor) 
parameters area_unit=(1*(0.54u+2.03u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor) 
parameters fn_total=(area_nf/area_unit) 
parameters ad_total=(0*0.8u/factor+fn_total*0.54u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor) 

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters wef_long=20e-6 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_long)?wef:wef_long 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_long)?1:wef_long/wef 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nld16g5anbl 
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=350  rd1=0.07  vdeff=1.3  vdmr=17.75  rdb0=0   rdw0=2.1e-5   rdw1=0  rdc0=1
parameters rd_weff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 

r1 ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res+rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rd_weff *drd) *((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) + rdc0*wfac_res* 
+ (1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0)    m=multi*nf
parameters cjswdn_nld16g5anbl_din=(cjswdn_nld16g5anbl*(pd-w)+cjswgdn_nld16g5anbl*w)/pd 
parameters jswdn_nld16g5anbl_din=(3.200e-13*(pd-w)+3.040e-13*w)/pd 

nld16_g5a_nbl_mac ( n11 n2 bs bs ) nld16_g5a_nbl w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf  ad=ad  as=as  pd=pd  ps=ps
//***** 1/f noise multi modification for fnoimod=0
parameters kf1=5e-029 
parameters af1=0.2 
parameters kffac=kf1*(pwr(abs(nf),(1-af1))) 

d_din ( bs n1 ) nld16_g5a_nbl_din area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=17.6*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

cb_sub ( bs sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=17.6*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {

}

parameters sofre=0.27 
parameters cap_drr=1u

gsoa ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(v(n1,bs)  < ((log(soaic0/soac1)+(soac3*v(n2,bs)+soac4))/

}

+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nld16g5anbl

+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf

+ nbl_pj=2*(aa*(3.42u+0u)/factor+nf*(l+(0.54u+0.93u)/factor)+bb*(1.71u+3.42u+3.42u)/factor+wef/factor+2*8.34u/factor)

parameters ad_total=(fn_total*(1.3u+0.93u)/factor+2*1.71u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*1.5u/factor)

parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2

parameters lef_short=0

grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (shflag_hv*sh_switch==0) {

} else if (cgb_switch==0) {

+  rdc0*wfac_res*(1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0),1e-2)    m=multi*nf
parameters cjswdn_nld16g5aiso_din=(cjswdn_nld16g5aiso*(pd-w))/pd 
parameters jswdn_nld16g5aiso_din=(3.500e-13*(pd-w)+3.500e-13*w)/pd

+ soac1)+(soac3*max(v(n21,bs),0)*max(v(n21,bs),0)+soac4*max(v(n21,bs),0)+soac5))/soac2))) 
+  m=multi*nf 
} else if (esoaflag_hv==0) {
}

//*** DRR ***

//*Diode Reverse Recovery Parameter
//*****************************
parameters tre2=max(min(max(4e-005*pwr(ad_total*factor*factor,1.5e-4)-3.9885e-5,5e-009),2.0e-008)*(1+(min(max(-1.28367e+004*ad_total*factor*factor+1.29098e-003,-3.758e-004),7.664e-004))*(temp-25)),5e-009) 
parameters sofre2=min((max((8.65313e+005*ad_total*factor*factor+1.6e-001),0.18)),0.30) 
parameters cap_drr2=1u 

//************ drr2 ***********
//*diode reverse recovery parameter
//*****************************
parameters tre=3e-8 
parameters sofre=0.3 
parameters cap_drr=1u 

if (drrflag_hv==1) {
d_din_dc ( bs_1 n1 ) nld16_g5a_iso_din_dc area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi
diso1_dc ( bs_2 nbl_iso ) shpdpwnblhvnw_dio_hv_iso_dc area=dpw_area_dc  pj=dpw_pj_dc  m=(nf/fn_total)*multi

//*****************************
//*drain to source
//*****************************
vdio_1 ( bs bs_1 ) vsource dc=0
fis_qrr ( bs n1 ) cccs probe=vtmp gain=-1
hqs1_qrr ( qs1a_1 qs2a ) ccvs probe=vdio_1 rm=tre2/cap_drr2
vtmp ( qs1a qs1a_1 ) vsource dc=0
hqs2_qrr ( qs2a 0 ) ccvs probe=vtmp rm=tre2*sofre2/cap_drr2
cs_qrr ( qs1a 0 ) capacitor       c=cap_drr2 

//*****************************
//*drain to source
//*****************************
vdio_2 ( bs bs_2 ) vsource dc=0
fis_qrr2 ( bs nbl_iso ) cccs probe=vtmp2 gain=-1
hqs1_qrr2 ( qs1b_1 qs2b ) ccvs probe=vdio_2 rm=tre/cap_drr
vtmp2 ( qs1b qs1b_1 ) vsource dc=0
hqs2_qrr2 ( qs2b 0 ) ccvs probe=vtmp2 rm=tre*sofre/cap_drr
cs_qrr2 ( qs1b 0 ) capacitor       c=cap_drr 

} else if (drrflag_hv==0) {
d_din_dc ( bs n1 ) nld16_g5a_iso_din_dc area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi
diso1_dc ( bs nbl_iso ) shpdpwnblhvnw_dio_hv_iso_dc area=dpw_area_dc  pj=dpw_pj_dc  m=(nf/fn_total)*multi
}

inline subckt nld20_g5a_nbl_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(aa*0.8u/factor+nf*0.54u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ pd=2*(aa*0.8u/factor+nf*0.54u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(aa*(2u+0.8u)/factor+bb*2.71u/factor+nf*(0.54u+2.43u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(aa*(2u+0.8u)/factor+bb*2.71u/factor+nf*(0.54u+2.43u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor))
+area_total=(0*(2u+0.8u)/factor+2*2.71u/factor+nf*(0.54u+2.43u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)
parameters area_nf=area_total-(0*(2u+0.8u)/factor+2*2.71u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor) 
parameters area_unit=(1*(0.54u+2.43u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor) 
parameters fn_total=(area_nf/area_unit) 
parameters ad_total=(0*0.8u/factor+fn_total*0.54u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor) 

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=0  sh_switch=0 
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=1862  rd1=-0.0658  vdeff=1.2973  vdmr=40.188 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=2.03e-05  rdw1=9.67e-03  rdt1=0.0003  rdt2=-1e-06
//*.param rdweff=rdw0*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1))*wfac_res
parameters rdweff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nld20g5anbl 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=9.99e-4  wrth0=1  k=1  rtht1=0  cth=1e-20
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (shflag_hv*sh_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (shflag_hv*sh_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter
parameters dgid=1 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub1w0=1e-018  sub1w1=0  sub2=0  sub3=0   sub4=1  ibt1=0  ibt2=0  ic0=1e-3
if (gid_switch==1) {
gid ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=1*(v(n1,bs)<(log(ic0/(1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,bs)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,bs)-(log(ic0/
+ (1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,bs)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}

parameters evg_type=1 
parameters evg_peak=7 
parameters evg_delta=0.01 
evg ( n21 n2 ) bsource  v=0.5  * (  (1.0e-3+(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs)+evg_type 
+ *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  - evg_type *sqrt( (1.0e-3-(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+
+ v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta))))) * (1.0e-3-(evg_peak -
+  (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  +  evg_delta 
+ ) )
//**combination
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=max((rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n21,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdleff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) +
+  rdc0*wfac_res*(1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0),1e-2)    m=multi*nf
parameters cjswdn_nld20g5anbl_din=(cjswdn_nld20g5anbl*(pd-w))/pd 
parameters jswdn_nld20g5anbl_din=(1.350e-12*(pd-w)+3.040e-13*w)/pd 

nld20_g5a_nbl_mac ( n11 n21 bs bs ) nld20_g5a_nbl  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf  as=as  ps=ps  ad=ad  pd=pd
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 bs ) capacitor      c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

cb_sub ( bs sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))


d_din ( bs n1 ) nld20_g5a_nbl_din area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi
d_din_g ( bs n1 ) nld20_g5a_nbl_din_g area=ad  pj=w  m=multi

if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_dti_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
}

parameters  soac1=1.00e-30   soac2=1.569   soac3=-0.610   soac4=0.000   soac5=1.000   soaic0=0.0321 
if (esoaflag_hv==1) {
gsoa ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(v(n1,bs)  < ((log(soaic0/soac1)+(soac3*max(v(n21,bs),0)*max(v(n21,bs),0)+
+ soac4*max(v(n21,bs),0)+soac5))/soac2) ? (soac1*exp(soac2*v(n1,bs)-(soac3*max(v(n21,bs),0)*max(v(n21,bs),0)+
+ soac4*max(v(n21,bs),0)+soac5))) : soaic0 + (soac2*soaic0) * (v(n1,bs) - ((log(soaic0/
+ soac1)+(soac3*max(v(n21,bs),0)*max(v(n21,bs),0)+soac4*max(v(n21,bs),0)+soac5))/soac2))) 
+  m=multi*nf 

} else if (esoaflag_hv==0) {
}

//*** DRR ***
//************ DRR ***********
//*Diode Reverse Recovery Parameter
//*****************************
parameters tre=max(min(max(6e-005*pwr(ad_total*factor*factor,3.3e-4)-5.9609e-5,5e-009),5e-008)*(1+(min(max(-1.0162e+005*ad_total*factor*factor-1.66587e-003,-5.22e-003),-2.50e-003))*(temp-25)),5e-009) 
parameters sofre=min(max((-1.28601e+007*ad_total*factor*factor+4.90278e-001),0.09),0.39) 
parameters cap_drr=1u 

if (drrflag_hv==1) {

//*****************************
//*drain to source
//*****************************
vdio_1 ( bs bs_1 ) vsource dc=0
fis_qrr ( bs n1 ) cccs probe=vtmp gain=-1
hqs1_qrr ( qs1a_1 qs2a ) ccvs probe=vdio_1 rm=tre/cap_drr
vtmp ( qs1a qs1a_1 ) vsource dc=0
hqs2_qrr ( qs2a 0 ) ccvs probe=vtmp rm=tre*sofre/cap_drr
cs_qrr ( qs1a 0 ) capacitor       c=cap_drr 

} else if (drrflag_hv==0) {
d_din_dc ( bs n1 ) nld20_g5a_nbl_din_dc area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi
}

//**Cgb parameter
parameters cgb_c1=-1.15e-09  cgb_c2=1.15e-09  cgb_c3=0.8  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=0.5 
if (cgb_switch==1) {
cgb ( n21 bs ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n21,bs))+cgb_c2*((v(n21,bs))  + (0.5 * (v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nld20g5anbl
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}

//***sw_ring_select***
real sel_sw_ring(real par, real sw_ring0, real sw_ring1, real sw_ring2) { 
return par<(sw_ring0+0.5)  ? 0 : par<(sw_ring1+0.5) ? 1 : par<(sw_ring2+0.5) ? 2 : 0;
}

parameters sw_ring_switch=sel_sw_ring(sw_ring,sw_ring0,sw_ring1,sw_ring2) 
parameters sw_ring0=0 
parameters sw_ring1=1 
parameters sw_ring2=2 

parameters wef_extend=20e-6 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nld20g5aiso 
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=2450  rd1=-0.1  vdeff=1.3  vdmr=50  rdt1=0  rdt2=0  rdw0=1.9e-5   rdw1=0.1
parameters rdweff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+  rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t)
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**combination

rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n21,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) + rdc0*wfac_res*(1-
+ (v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0)    m=multi*nf
parameters cjswdn_nld20g5aiso_din=(cjswdn_nld20g5aiso*(pd-w))/pd 
parameters jswdn_nld20g5aiso_din=(3.500e-13*(pd-w)+3.500e-13*w)/pd

d_din_g ( bs n1 ) nld20_g5a_iso_din_g area=ad  pj=w  m=multi
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
