//*******************************************************************************************
//*                                                                                         *
//*                  MOS 0.18UM BCD GEN2 NLD24_G5A_NBL DEVICE MODELS                      *
//*                                                                                         *
//*******************************************************************************************
inline subckt nld24_g5a_nbl_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1  dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(aa*1.3u/factor+nf*0.54u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor)
+ pd=2*(aa*1.3u/factor+nf*0.54u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(aa*(2u+1.3u)/factor+bb*3.21u/factor+nf*(0.54u+2.83u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(aa*(2u+1.3u)/factor+bb*3.21u/factor+nf*(0.54u+2.83u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*3u/factor))
+ area_total=(0*(2u+1.3u)/factor+2*3.21u/factor+nf*(0.54u+2.83u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3u/factor)
parameters area_nf=area_total-(0*(2u+1.3u)/factor+2*3.21u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3u/factor) 
parameters area_unit=(1*(0.54u+2.83u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3u/factor) 
parameters fn_total=(area_nf/area_unit) 
parameters ad_total=(0*1.3u/factor+fn_total*0.54u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor) 

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=1  sh_switch=1 
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=2604.4  rd1=-0.07746  vdeff=1.2792  vdmr=48.716 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=1.723e-005   rdw1=0.10794   rdt1=0.00055485   rdt2=-4.832e-007
parameters rdweff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nld24g5anbl 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=0.0094193  wrth0=3.4726e-005  k=1.4  rtht1=0.0069  cth=1e-012
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef_res+wrth0)*wfac_res*rthtemp 
if (sh_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (sh_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter 
parameters dgid=1 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub1w0=2e-019  sub1w1=0  sub2=1.4038  sub3=1.66   sub4=1  ibt1=-0.0044  ibt2=0  ic0=1e-3
if (gid_switch==1) {
gid ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=1*(v(n1,bs)<(log(ic0/(1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,bs)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,bs)-(log(ic0/
+ (1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,bs)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}


//******
parameters evg_type=1 
parameters evg_peak=9.1 
parameters evg_delta=0.01 
evg ( n21 n2 ) bsource  v=0.5  * (  (1.0e-3+(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs)+evg_type 
+ *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  - evg_type *sqrt( (1.0e-3-(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+
+ v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta))))) * (1.0e-3-(evg_peak -
+  (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  +  evg_delta 
+ ) )

//**cgb parameter
parameters cgb_c1=-1.5e-09  cgb_c2=1.5e-09  cgb_c3=0.8  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=0.1 
if (cgb_switch==1) {
cgb ( n21 bs ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n21,bs))+cgb_c2*((v(n21,bs))  + (0.5 * (v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nld24g5anbl
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}
//**Combination 
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=max((rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n21,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdleff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) +
+  rdc0*wfac_res*(1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0),1e-2)    m=multi*nf
nld24_g5a_nbl_mac ( n11 n21 bs bs ) nld24_g5a_nbl  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf   as=as  ad=ad  ps=ps  pd=pd

//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=26.4*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 bs ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=26.4*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cb_sub ( bs sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=26.4*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=26.4*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))


//**dinds
parameters cjswdn_nld24g5anbl_din=(cjswdn_nld24g5anbl*(pd-w)+cjswgdn_nld24g5anbl*w)/pd 
parameters jswdn_nld24g5anbl_din=(3.200e-13*(pd-w)+3.040e-13*w)/pd 

d_din ( bs n1 ) nld24_g5a_nbl_din area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi

if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_dti_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
}

//*** DRR ***
if (drrflag_hv==1) {
d_din_dc ( bs1 n1 ) nld24_g5a_nbl_din_dc area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi

//************ drr ***********
//*diode reverse recovery parameter
//*****************************
parameters tre=max(min(max(6.5e-005*pwr(ad_total*factor*factor,7.2e-4)-6.41152e-5,5e-009),8e-008)*(1+(min(max(-1.20816e+005*ad_total*factor*factor-1.31514e-003,-5.49e-003),-2.38e-003))*(temp-25)),5e-009) 
parameters sofre=max(min(max((-9.25926e+006*ad_total*factor*factor+4.02e-001),0.11),0.33)*(1+(min(max(4.8011e+005*ad_total*factor*factor-2.62222e-003,2.4e-003),1.32e-002))*(temp-25)),0.11) 
parameters cap_drr=1u 
//*****************************
//*drain to source
//*****************************
vdio_ve ( bs bs1 ) vsource dc=0
fis_qrr ( bs n1 ) cccs probe=vtmp gain=-1
hqs1_qrr ( qs1_1 qs2 ) ccvs probe=vdio_ve rm=tre/cap_drr
vtmp ( qs1 qs1_1 ) vsource dc=0
hqs2_qrr ( qs2 0 ) ccvs probe=vtmp rm=tre*sofre/cap_drr
cs_qrr ( qs1 0 ) capacitor       c=cap_drr 

} else if (drrflag_hv==0) {
d_din_dc ( bs n1 ) nld24_g5a_nbl_din_dc area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi
}

//*******************************************************************************************
//*                                                                                         *
//*                      mos 0.18um bcd gen2 na6_g5a_nbl device models                      *
//*                                                                                         *
//*******************************************************************************************
inline subckt na6_g5a_nbl_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 sigma=1 dti=0 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_hv
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*(l+1.05u/factor)+aa*0u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*(l+1.05u/factor)+aa*0u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(aa*(0u+0u)/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+1.33u)/factor)+bb*1.71u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3.5u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(aa*(0u+0u)/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+1.33u)/factor)+bb*1.71u/factor+wef/factor+2*3.5u/factor)

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters lef=l*factor 

//**** mismatch ***
parameters
+temp1=par1n_hv  temp2=par2n_hv  temp3=par3n_hv  temp4=par4n_hv  temp5=par5n_hv 

+mis_a_1=0.0073  mis_a_2=-0.1  mis_a_3=0.1 
+mis_b_1=0.0014  mis_b_2=0.1  mis_b_3=0.45 
+mis_c_1=0.65  mis_c_2=0  mis_c_3=0 
+mis_d_1=2.03e-3  mis_d_2=0  mis_d_3=0 
+mis_e_1=0.0094  mis_e_2=-0.15  mis_e_3=0.1  e_limit=2

+a=mis_a_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_a_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_a_3) 
+b=mis_b_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_b_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_b_3) 
+c=mis_c_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_c_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_c_3) 
+d=mis_d_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_d_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_d_3) 
+e=mis_e_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_e_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_e_3) 

+fac1=temp1 
+fac2=temp2 
+fac3=temp3 
+fac4=temp4 
+fac5=c*temp4+sqrt(1-c*c)*temp5 

+geo_fac=1/sqrt(multi*nf*lef*wef*1e12)*mismatchflag*sigma 
+toxmis_na6g5anbl=d*geo_fac*toxn_na6g5anbl*fac1 
+dxlmis_na6g5anbl=b*geo_fac*lef*fac2 
+dxwmis_na6g5anbl=-b*geo_fac*wef*fac3 
+dvthmis_na6g5anbl=a*geo_fac*fac4 
+fu0mis_na6g5anbl=min(e_limit,1+e*geo_fac*fac5) 

na6_g5a_nbl_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) na6_g5a_nbl w=w  l=l  ad=ad  as=as  pd=pd  ps=ps  m=multi  nf=nf

//***** parasitic c for soa check
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=6.6*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cb_sub ( n4 sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=6.6*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_dti_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
}

parameters cgb_c1=-1.75e-09  cgb_c2=1.75e-09  cgb_c3=1.8  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=0.3

parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*(l+1.05u/factor)+aa*0u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*(l+1.05u/factor)+aa*0u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ hvnw_area=(aa*(0u+0u)/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+1.53u)/factor)+bb*1.21u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3.5u/factor)
+ hvnw_pj=2*(aa*(0u+0u)/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+1.53u)/factor)+bb*1.21u/factor+wef/factor+2*3.5u/factor)
parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
nda6_g3a_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) nda6_g3a l=l  w=w  m=multi  nf=nf  as=as  ps=ps  ad=ad  pd=pd

} else if (dti==1) {

}

+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n2,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*dcgbn_nda6g3a

+ (v(n1,n3)>0)?1:0)     m=multi*nf

//*                       MOS 0.18UM BCD GEN2 NDA29_G3A_NBL DEVICE MODELS                       *

inline subckt nda29_g3a_nbl_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*(l+1.05u/factor)+aa*0u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.1u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*(l+1.05u/factor)+aa*0u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*2.1u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(aa*(0u+0u)/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+3.81u)/factor)+bb*3.21u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3.5u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(aa*(0u+0u)/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+3.81u)/factor)+bb*3.21u/factor+wef/factor+2*3.5u/factor)

parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=0  sh_switch=1 
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=2e-5 
parameters lef_short=1.1e-6 
parameters rdl0=1 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=763  rd1=-0.0186  vdeff=1.4741  vdmr=20.528 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=7e-005   rdw1=-0.89   rdt1=0   rdt2=0
parameters rdweff=rdw0*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1))*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nda29g3anbl 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
parameters rd0rev=303.41   vgeffrev=1.663   vgmrrev=7.8358 
parameters vsmr0rev=3.0983   vsmr1rev=0.01   rdw0rev=0.006329   rdw1rev=-0.49
parameters rdweffrev=rdw0rev*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1rev))*wfac_res 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=0.004  wrth0=8.6e-006  k=1.4  rtht1=0  cth=1e-020
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (sh_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 n3 ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,n3)) 
} else if (sh_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter
parameters dgid=1+0 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub1w0=1e-018  sub1w1=0  sub2=0  sub3=0   sub4=1  ibt1=0  ibt2=0  ic0=1e-3
if (gid_switch==1) {
gid ( n1 n4 ) bsource  i=1*(v(n1,n3)<(log(ic0/(1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,n3),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,n3),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,n3)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,n3)-(log(ic0/
+ (1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+abs(max(v(n21,n3),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,n3)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter
parameters cgb_c1=-2.3e-9  cgb_c2=2.3e-9  cgb_c3=0.8  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=1.50 
if (cgb_switch==1) {
cgb ( n21 n4 ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n21,n4))+cgb_c2*((v(n21,n4))  + (0.5 * (v(n21,n4)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n21,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,n4)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nda29g3anbl
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}
parameters evg_type=1 
parameters evg_peak=5.3 
parameters evg_delta=0.01 
evg ( n21 n2 ) bsource  v=0.5  * (  (1.0e-3+(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,n3)+evg_type 
+ *sqrt((v(n1,n3)*v(n1,n3))+evg_delta)))))  - evg_type *sqrt( (1.0e-3-(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+
+ v(n2,n3) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,n3)*v(n1,n3))+evg_delta))))) * (1.0e-3-(evg_peak -
+  (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,n3) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,n3)*v(n1,n3))+evg_delta)))))  +  evg_delta 
+ ) )
//**combination
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=max((rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n21,n3)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3))),vdeff)/vdmr) * (1+rdb0*v(n4,n3)) * rdweff * rdleff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,n3)>0)?1:0) 
+ + (rdc0*wfac_res + rd0rev * tanh(pwr(1e-5+abs(v(n21,n1)),vgeffrev)/vgmrrev) * tanh((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3)))/(vsmr0rev * exp(vsmr1rev * v(n21,n1)))) * rdweffrev * drd) * (1-(v(n1,n3)>0)?1:0) 
+ ,1e-2)    m=multi*nf
parameters cjswdn_nda29g3anbl_din=(cjswdn_nda29g3anbl*(pd-w))/pd 
parameters cjswsn_nda29g3anbl_s=(cjswsn_nda29g3anbl*(ps-w))/ps 
parameters jswdn_nda29g3anbl_din=(5.6e-013*(pd-w)+5.6e-013*w)/pd 
parameters jswsn_nda29g3anbl_s=(1.32e-013*(ps-w)+1.33e-013*w)/ps 

nda29_g3a_nbl_mac ( n11 n21 n3 n4 ) nda29_g3a_nbl  l=l  w=w  m=multi  nf=nf  as=as  ps=ps  ad=ad  pd=pd
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=31.9*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 n3 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=31.9*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

inline subckt na29_g5a_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0 sigma=1
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf

parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=1  sh_switch=1 
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=2e-005 
parameters lef_short=1.3e-6 
parameters rdl0=1 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=2720  rd1=0  vdeff=1.2376  vdmr=50 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=5.437e-005  rdw1=-0.9091  rdt1=0.0006   rdt2=0

//**rd reverse parameter

parameters rd0rev=1428.7  vgeffrev=0.8816   vgmrrev=26.16 
parameters vsmr0rev=5.1  vsmr1rev=0   rdw0rev=0.0002838  rdw1rev=-0.758

} else if (sh_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter

+ abs(max(v(n21,n3),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,n3),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,n3)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,n3)-(log(ic0/
+ (1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+abs(max(v(n21,n3),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,n3)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter
parameters cgb_c1=-1.24e-9  cgb_c2=1.24e-9  cgb_c3=0.4  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=1

+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf

parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor

+temp1=par1p_hv  temp2=par2p_hv  temp3=par3p_hv  temp4=par4p_hv  temp5=par5p_hv

+c=mis_c_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_c_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_c_3) 
+d=mis_d_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_d_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_d_3)

+fac1=temp1 
+fac2=temp2 
+fac3=temp3 
+fac4=temp4

inline subckt pa8_g5a_nbl_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*1.13u/factor+aa*0u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*1.13u/factor+aa*0u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(bb*1.71u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+1.13u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3.92u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(bb*1.71u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+1.13u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+wef/factor+2*3.92u/factor)
parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef_extend=20e-6 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters drd=1 
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=730  rd1=0  vdeff=1.3  vdmr=22  rdb0=0.05   rdw0=2.25e-05   rdw1=-0.0959   rdc0=1
parameters rd_weff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rd0rev=360   vgeffrev=2   vgmrrev=40   vsmr0rev=0.1142   vsmr1rev=-0.5134   rdw0rev=1.683e-05   rdw1rev=0.222
parameters rd_weff_rev=(rdw0rev/wef_res+rdw1rev)*wfac_res 
//**combination
r1 ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res+(rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,n3)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3))),vdeff)/vdmr) * (1+rdb0*v(n4,n3)) * rd_weff) *drd) *((v(n1,n3)<0)?1:0)+
+  (rdc0*wfac_res+(rd0rev * tanh(pwr(1e-5+abs(v(n2,n1)),vgeffrev)/vgmrrev) * tanh((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3)))/(vsmr0rev * exp(vsmr1rev * v(n2,n1)))) * rd_weff_rev)* drd )* (1-(v(n1,n3)<0)?1:0) 
+     m=multi*nf
pa8_g5a_nbl_mac ( n11 n2 n3 n4 ) pa8_g5a_nbl l=l  w=w  m=multi  nf=nf  as=as  ps=ps  ad=ad  pd=pd
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=8.8*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 n3 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=8.8*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

} else if (dti==1) {

}
parameters cgb_c1=-5.76e-10  cgb_c2=5.76e-10  cgb_c3=0.8  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=0.1 
cgb ( n2 n4 ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n4,n2))+cgb_c2*((v(n4,n2))  - (0.5 * (v(n4,n2)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ - (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*dcgbp_pa8g5anbl

//*******************************************************************************************
//*                                                                                         *
//*                       mos 0.18um bcd gen2 pa12_g5a_nbl device models                    *
//*                                                                                         *
//*******************************************************************************************
inline subckt pa12_g5a_nbl_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*1.23u/factor+aa*0u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*1.23u/factor+aa*0u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(bb*1.71u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+1.23u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3.92u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(bb*1.71u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+1.23u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+wef/factor+2*3.92u/factor)

parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=6800  rd1=0.18  vdeff=1.6  vdmr=75  rdb0=0.08   rdw0=2.3e-005   rdw1=-0.98   rdt1=0   rdt2=0
parameters rdweff=rdw0*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1))*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdp_pa12g5anbl 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
parameters rd0rev=1275  vgeffrev=1.3   vgmrrev=40 
parameters vsmr0rev=0.4674   vsmr1rev=-0.3529   rdw0rev=1.96e-5   rdw1rev=-1
parameters rdweffrev=rdw0rev*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1rev))*wfac_res 
//**cgb parameter
parameters cgb_c1=-4.5e-10  cgb_c2=4.5e-10  cgb_c3=0.9  cgb_c4=0.12  cgb_c5=0.5 
cgb ( n2 n4 ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n4,n2))+cgb_c2*((v(n4,n2))  - (0.5 * (v(n4,n2)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ - (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbp_pa12g5anbl
//**combination
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,n3)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3))),vdeff)/vdmr) * (1+rdb0*v(n4,n3)) * rdweff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,n3)<0?1:0)) 
+ + (rdc0*wfac_res + rd0rev * tanh(pwr(1e-5+abs(v(n2,n1)),vgeffrev)/vgmrrev) * tanh((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3)))/(vsmr0rev * exp(vsmr1rev * v(n2,n1)))) * rdweffrev * drd) * (1-(v(n1,n3)<0?1:0)) 
+     m=multi*nf

parameters cjswdp_pa12g5anbl_din=(cjswdp_pa12g5anbl*(pd-w))/pd 
parameters cjswsp_pa12g5anbl_s=(cjswsp_pa12g5anbl*(ps-w))/ps 
parameters jswdp_pa12g5anbl_din=(1.650e-12*(pd-w)+1.650e-12*w)/pd 
parameters jswsp_pa12g5anbl_s=(1.400e-12*(ps-w)+1.000e-12*w)/ps 

pa12_g5a_nbl_mac ( n11 n2 n3 n4 ) pa12_g5a_nbl  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf  as=as  ps=ps  ad=ad  pd=pd

d_din ( n1 n4 ) pa12_g5a_nbl_din area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi
d_din_g ( n1 n4 ) pa12_g5a_nbl_din_g area=ad  pj=w  m=multi
d_s ( n3 n4 ) pa12_g5a_nbl_s area=as  pj=ps  m=multi
d_s_g ( n3 n4 ) pa12_g5a_nbl_s_g area=as  pj=w  m=multi
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=13.2*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 n3 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=13.2*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cbd ( n4 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=13.2*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

cb_sub ( n4 sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=13.2*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=13.2*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n4 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {
diso1 ( sub n4 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_dti_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
}

//*******************************************************************************************
//*                                                                                         *
//*                       mos 0.18um bcd gen2 pa16_g5a_nbl device models                    *
//*                                                                                         *
//*******************************************************************************************
inline subckt pa16_g5a_nbl_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*1.33u/factor+aa*0u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*1.33u/factor+aa*0u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(bb*1.71u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+1.33u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3.92u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(bb*1.71u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+1.33u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+wef/factor+2*3.92u/factor)

parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=9650  rd1=0.18  vdeff=1.52  vdmr=92  rdb0=0.08   rdw0=2.3e-005   rdw1=-0.98   rdt1=5e-4   rdt2=0
parameters rdweff=rdw0*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1))*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdp_pa16g5anbl 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
parameters rd0rev=1360  vgeffrev=1.3   vgmrrev=40 
parameters vsmr0rev=0.4674   vsmr1rev=-0.3529   rdw0rev=1.96e-5   rdw1rev=-1
parameters rdweffrev=rdw0rev*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1rev))*wfac_res 
//**cgb parameter
parameters cgb_c1=-3.5e-10  cgb_c2=3.5e-10  cgb_c3=1.43  cgb_c4=0.12  cgb_c5=0.852 
cgb ( n2 n4 ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n4,n2))+cgb_c2*((v(n4,n2))  - (0.5 * (v(n4,n2)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ - (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbp_pa16g5anbl
//**combination
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,n3)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3))),vdeff)/vdmr) * (1+rdb0*v(n4,n3)) * rdweff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,n3)<0?1:0)) 
+ + (rdc0*wfac_res + rd0rev * tanh(pwr(1e-5+abs(v(n2,n1)),vgeffrev)/vgmrrev) * tanh((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3)))/(vsmr0rev * exp(vsmr1rev * v(n2,n1)))) * rdweffrev * drd) * (1-(v(n1,n3)<0?1:0)) 
+     m=multi*nf

parameters cjswdp_pa16g5anbl_din=(cjswdp_pa16g5anbl*(pd-w))/pd 
parameters cjswsp_pa16g5anbl_s=(cjswsp_pa16g5anbl*(ps-w))/ps 
parameters jswdp_pa16g5anbl_din=(1.650e-12*(pd-w)+1.650e-12*w)/pd 
parameters jswsp_pa16g5anbl_s=(1.400e-12*(ps-w)+1.000e-12*w)/ps 

pa16_g5a_nbl_mac ( n11 n2 n3 n4 ) pa16_g5a_nbl  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf  as=as  ps=ps  ad=ad  pd=pd

d_din ( n1 n4 ) pa16_g5a_nbl_din area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi
d_din_g ( n1 n4 ) pa16_g5a_nbl_din_g area=ad  pj=w  m=multi
d_s ( n3 n4 ) pa16_g5a_nbl_s area=as  pj=ps  m=multi
d_s_g ( n3 n4 ) pa16_g5a_nbl_s_g area=as  pj=w  m=multi
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=17.6*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 n3 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=17.6*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cbd ( n4 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=17.6*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

cb_sub ( n4 sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=17.6*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=17.6*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n4 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {
diso1 ( sub n4 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_dti_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
}

//*                                                                                         *
//*                      mos 0.18um bcd gen2 pa20_g5a_nbl device models                     *
//*                                                                                         *
//*******************************************************************************************
inline subckt pa20_g5a_nbl_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*1.63u/factor+aa*0u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*1.63u/factor+aa*0u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(bb*2.21u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+1.63u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*4.92u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(bb*2.21u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+1.63u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+wef/factor+2*4.92u/factor)

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef_extend=20.001e-6 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters drd=1+drdp_pa20g5anbl 
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=24013  rd1=0.0726  vdeff=1.3  vdmr=350  rdb0=0.01  rdw0=2.0e-5   rdw1=0.05   rdc0=1
parameters rd_weff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rd0rev=80   vgeffrev=2   vgmrrev=40   vsmr0rev=0.3675   vsmr1rev=-0.2835   rdw0rev=1.8e-5   rdw1rev=0.1
parameters rd_weff_rev=(rdw0rev/wef_res+rdw1rev)*wfac_res 
//**combination
r1 ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res+(rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,n3)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3))),vdeff)/vdmr) * (1+rdb0*v(n4,n3)) * rd_weff) *drd )*((v(n1,n3)<0)?1:0)+
+  (rdc0*wfac_res+(rd0rev * tanh(pwr(1e-5+abs(v(n2,n1)),vgeffrev)/vgmrrev) * tanh((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3)))/(vsmr0rev * exp(vsmr1rev * v(n2,n1)))) * rd_weff_rev)* drd )* (1-(v(n1,n3)<0)?1:0) 
+  m=multi*nf
pa20_g5a_nbl_mac ( n11 n2 n3 n4 ) pa20_g5a_nbl l=l  w=w  m=multi  nf=nf  as=as  ps=ps  ad=ad  pd=pd
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 n3 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cbd ( n4 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cb_sub ( n4 sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n4 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {
diso1 ( sub n4 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_dti_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
}

parameters cgb_c1=-5.5e-10  cgb_c2=5.5e-10  cgb_c3=0.8  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=1.3 
cgb ( n2 n4 ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n4,n2))+cgb_c2*((v(n4,n2))  - (0.5 * (v(n4,n2)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ - (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbp_pa20g5anbl

//*                                                                                         *     
//*                      MOS 0.18UM BCD GEN2 NLD20_G5B DEVICE MODELS                        *

inline subckt nld20_g5b_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*((0.54u+0.1u+2.43u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(2.21u+4.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+
+ 2*6.42u/factor)-(nf*2.43u/factor+bb*2.21u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*((0.54u+0.1u+2.43u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(2.21u+4.42u)/factor+(wef/
+ factor+2*6.42u/factor))+(2*(nf*2.43u/factor+bb*2.21u/factor)+(nf+bb)*(wef/factor+
+ 2*2u/factor))
+ nbl_area=(nf*((0.54u+0.1u+2.43u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(2.21u+4.42u+4.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*10.84u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(nf*((0.54u+0.1u+2.43u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(2.21u+4.42u+4.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*10.84u/factor))
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef=w/nf*factor 

parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 

parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=1  sh_switch=0 
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=4413.5  rd1=-0.1124  vdeff=1.28  vdmr=37.8 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=1.7e-5   rdw1=0.1531   rdt1=0.0004   rdt2=0
parameters rdweff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nld20g5b 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=9.99e-4  wrth0=1  k=1  rtht1=0  cth=1e-20
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (shflag_hv*sh_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (shflag_hv*sh_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter
parameters dgid=1+dgidn_nld20g5b 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub1w0=6.3e-11  sub1w1=-1.4e-16  sub2=2  sub3=1.6   sub4=0.35  ibt1=-0.009  ibt2=4e-005  ic0=2.5e-02
if (gid_switch==1) {
gid ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=1*(v(n1,bs)<(log(ic0/(1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,bs)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,bs)-(log(ic0/
+ (1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,bs)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter
parameters cgb_c1=-7.15e-10  cgb_c2=7.15e-10  cgb_c3=0.6  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=0.1 
if (cgb_switch==1) {
cgb ( n21 bs ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n21,bs))+cgb_c2*((v(n21,bs))  + (0.5 * (v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*dcgbn_nld20g5b
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}
//**
parameters evg_type=1 
parameters evg_peak=7.15 
parameters evg_delta=0.01 
evg ( n21 n2 ) bsource  v=0.5  * (  (1.0e-3+(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs)+evg_type 
+ *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  - evg_type *sqrt( (1.0e-3-(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+
+ v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta))))) * (1.0e-3-(evg_peak -
+  (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  +  evg_delta 
+ ) )

//**combination
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=max((rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n21,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdleff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) +
+  rdc0*wfac_res*(1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0),1e-2)    m=multi*nf
nld20_g5b_mac ( n11 n21 bs bs ) nld20_g5b  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf  as=as  ad=ad  ps=ps  pd=pd
//***** 1/f noise multi modification for fnoimod=0
parameters kf1=26e-029 
parameters af1=0.42 
parameters kffac=kf1*(pwr(abs(nf),(1-af1))) 
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 bs ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cb_sub ( bs sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) nblpepi_iso_dio area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubhvpw_dio_dti_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
}

//*******************************************************************************************     
//*                                                                                         *     
//*                      MOS 0.18UM BCD GEN2 NLD24_G5B DEVICE MODELS                        *     
//*                                                                                         *     
//******************************************************************************************* 
inline subckt nld24_g5b_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*((0.54u+0.1u+2.73u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(2.21u+4.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+
+ 2*6.42u/factor)-(nf*2.73u/factor+bb*2.21u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*((0.54u+0.1u+2.73u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(2.21u+4.42u)/factor+(wef/
+ factor+2*6.42u/factor))+(2*(nf*2.73u/factor+bb*2.21u/factor)+(nf+bb)*(wef/factor+
+ 2*2u/factor))
+ nbl_area=(nf*((0.54u+0.1u+2.73u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(2.21u+4.42u+4.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*10.84u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(nf*((0.54u+0.1u+2.73u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(2.21u+4.42u+4.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*10.84u/factor))
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_extend=20e-6 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=1  sh_switch=0 
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=4900  rd1=-0.0955  vdeff=1.3  vdmr=50 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=1.69e-5   rdw1=0.15   rdt1=0.001038   rdt2=-4.224e-6
parameters rdweff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nld24g5b 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=9.99e-4  wrth0=1  k=1  rtht1=0  cth=1e-20
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (shflag_hv*sh_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (shflag_hv*sh_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter
parameters dgid=1+dgidn_nld24g5b 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub1w0=1.7e-10  sub1w1=0  sub2=1.4  sub3=3.2   sub4=0.22  ibt1=-0.7e-2  ibt2=3.5e-5  ic0=2.5e-02

if (gid_switch==1) {
gid ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=1*(v(n1,bs)<(log(ic0/(1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,bs)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,bs)-(log(ic0/
+ (1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,bs)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter
parameters cgb_c1=-5.85e-10  cgb_c2=5.85e-10  cgb_c3=0.9  cgb_c4=0.01  cgb_c5=0.2 
if (cgb_switch==1) {
cgb ( n21 bs ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n21,bs))+cgb_c2*((v(n21,bs))  + (0.5 * (v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nld24g5b
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}
//**
parameters evg_type=1 
parameters evg_peak=6.75 
parameters evg_delta=0.01 
evg ( n21 n2 ) bsource  v=0.5  * (  (1.0e-3+(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs)+evg_type 
+ *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  - evg_type *sqrt( (1.0e-3-(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+
+ v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta))))) * (1.0e-3-(evg_peak -
+  (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  +  evg_delta 
+ ) )

//**combination
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=max((rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n21,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdleff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) +
+  rdc0*wfac_res*(1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0),1e-2)    m=multi*nf
nld24_g5b_mac ( n11 n21 bs bs ) nld24_g5b  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf  as=as  ad=ad  ps=ps  pd=pd

//***** 1/f noise multi modification for fnoimod=0
parameters kf1=8.0e-29 
parameters af1=0.21 
parameters kffac=kf1*(pwr(abs(nf),(1-af1))) 
//***** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=26.4*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 bs ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=26.4*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=26.4*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cb_sub ( bs sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=26.4*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) nblpepi_iso_dio area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubhvpw_dio_dti_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
}

//*******************************************************************************************     
//*                                                                                         *     
//*                      MOS 0.18UM BCD GEN2 NDA24_G3B DEVICE MODELS                        *     
//*                                                                                         *     
//******************************************************************************************* 
inline subckt nda24_g3b_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*(l+(1.05u+3.93u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(2.21u+4.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*6.42u/factor)-(nf*3.93u/factor+bb*2.21u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*(l+(1.05u+3.93u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(2.21u+4.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+
+ 2*6.42u/factor))+(2*(nf*3.93u/factor+bb*2.21u/factor)+(nf+bb)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor))
+ nbl_area=(nf*(l+(1.05u+3.93u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(2.21u+4.42u+4.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*10.84u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(nf*(l+(1.05u+3.93u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(2.21u+4.42u+4.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*10.84u/factor))
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_long=20e-6 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_long)?wef:wef_long 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_long)?1:wef_long/wef 
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=20e-6 
parameters lef_short=8e-7 
parameters lef_res=(lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nda24g3b 
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=18695.88  rd1=-0.0317  vdeff=1.25  vdmr=330  rdb0=-0.02   rdw0=2e-005   rdw1=0  rdt0=0.003  rdt1=-4e-5  rdc0=1
parameters rd_weff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
parameters rdt_eff=(1+  rdt0*delta_t+rdt1*delta_t*delta_t)
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rd0_rev=580  vgeff_rev=0.7   vgmr_rev=6.3   vsmr0_rev=2.9033   vsmr1_rev=-0.1097   rdw0_rev=1.12857e-005   rdw1_rev=0.45
parameters rd_weff_rev=(rdw0_rev/wef_res+rdw1_rev)*wfac_res 
//**combination
r1 ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=( rdc0*wfac_res+ (rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,n3)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3))),vdeff)/vdmr) * (1+rdb0*v(n4,n3)) * rd_weff * lef_res) * rdt_eff * 
+ drd )*((v(n1,n3)>0)?1:0)+ ( rdc0*wfac_res+ (rd0_rev * tanh(pwr(1e-5+abs(v(n2,n1)),vgeff_rev)/
+ vgmr_rev) * tanh((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n3)))/(vsmr0_rev * exp(vsmr1_rev * v(n2,n1)))) *

inline subckt nld36_g5b_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*(l+(0.54u+3.53u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+
+ 2*7.92u/factor)-(nf*3.53u/factor+bb*2.71u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*(l+(0.54u+3.53u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+
+ 2*7.92u/factor))+(2*(nf*3.53u/factor+bb*2.71u/factor)+(nf+bb)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/
+ factor))
+ nbl_area=(nf*(l+(0.54u+3.53u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u+5.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*13.34u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(nf*(l+(0.54u+3.53u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u+5.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*13.34u/factor))
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_extend=2e-5 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nld36g5b 
parameters dgid=1+dgidn_nld36g5b 
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=1087.48882  rd1=0.06454  vdeff=1.3  vdmr=50  rdb0=0   rdw0=2e-5   rdw1=-1   rdt1=0   rdt2=0
parameters rdweff=(rdw0*pwr(abs(wef_res),rdw1))*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
parameters sub1_w0=1.6e-9  sub1_w1=6e-15  sub2=1.2  sub3_w0=4.8  sub3_w1=-6e-6  sub4=0.04  ibt0=-6.0e-3  ibt1=0
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters temp_isub=(1+ibt0*delta_t+ibt1*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1_weff=sub1_w0+sub1_w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub3_weff=sub3_w0+sub3_w1/wef_isub 
parameters ic0=2.5e-02 
//**combination
r1 ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) + rdc0*wfac_res*(1-

inline subckt nld45_g5b_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*(l+(0.54u+4.03u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+

+ 2*7.92u/factor))+(2*(nf*4.03u/factor+bb*2.71u/factor)+(nf+bb)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/
+ factor))
+ nbl_area=(nf*(l+(0.54u+4.03u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u+5.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*13.34u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(nf*(l+(0.54u+4.03u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u+5.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*13.34u/factor))
parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef_extend=20e-6 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nld45g5b 
//*rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=5341  rd1=-0.0429  vdeff=1.37  vdmr=90.54  rdb0=0  rdt0=0.0008  rdt1=0  rdw0=1.7e-5  rdw1=0.1463  rdc0=1

//*rd reverse parameter
//*combination
parameters rdt_eff=(1+  rdt0*delta_t+rdt1*delta_t*delta_t)
r1 ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res+rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdt_eff * rd_weff*drd )*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) +rdc0*wfac_res* 
+ (1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0)    m=multi*nf

+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n2,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5))))

//*******************************************************************************************     
//*                                                                                         *     
//*                      MOS 0.18UM BCD GEN2 PA20_G5B DEVICE MODELS                         *     
//*                                                                                         *     
//******************************************************************************************* 
inline subckt pa20_g5b_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*2.61u/factor+aa*0u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*2.61u/factor+aa*0u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(bb*2.99u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+2.61u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*6.42u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(bb*2.99u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+2.61u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+wef/factor+2*6.42u/factor)
parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef_long=20e-6 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_long)?wef:wef_long 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_long)?1:wef_long/wef 
parameters drd=1+drdp_pa20g5b 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=11449  rd1=0.074  vdeff=1.22124  vdmr=50.749  rdb0=0  rdw0=9.55e-6  rdw1=0.0414  rdt0=0.0005  rdt1=0  rdc0=1
parameters rd_weff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rd0rev=210   vgeffrev=2.35   vgmrrev=60   vsmr0rev=1.5   vsmr1rev=0   rdw0rev=1e-5   rdw1rev=0.3
parameters rd_weff_rev=(rdw0rev/wef_res+rdw1rev)*wfac_res 
//**combination
parameters rdt_eff=(1+  rdt0*delta_t+rdt1*delta_t*delta_t)
r1 ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res+(rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,n3)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3))),vdeff)/vdmr) * (1+rdb0*v(n4,n3)) * rd_weff) * rdt_eff *drd) *((v(n1,n3)<0)?1:0)+
+  (rdc0*wfac_res+(rd0rev * tanh(pwr(1e-5+abs(v(n2,n1)),vgeffrev)/vgmrrev) * tanh((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3)))/(vsmr0rev * exp(vsmr1rev * v(n2,n1)))) * rd_weff_rev)* drd) * (1-(v(n1,n3)<0)?1:0) 
+     m=multi*nf
pa20_g5b_mac ( n11 n2 n3 n4 ) pa20_g5b w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf  ad=ad  as=as  pd=pd  ps=ps
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 n3 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cbd ( n4 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cb_sub ( n4 sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=22*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n4 ) nblpepi_iso_dio area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {
diso1 ( sub n4 ) hvnwnblpsubhvpw_dio_dti_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
}
//***cgb
parameters cgb_c1=-8.46e-10  cgb_c2=8.46e-10  cgb_c3=1.0  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=0.15

//*                                                                                         *     
//*                      MOS 0.18UM BCD GEN2 PA36_G5B DEVICE MODELS                         *     
//*                                                                                         *

inline subckt pa36_g5b_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*2.61u/factor+aa*0u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*2.61u/factor+aa*0u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*2u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(bb*2.99u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+2.61u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*6.42u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(bb*2.99u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+2.61u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+wef/factor+2*6.42u/factor)
parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef_extend=20e-6 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters drd=1+drdp_pa36g5b 
//*rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=18066.3  rd1=0.064  vdeff=1.23199    vdmr=83.2321    rdb0=0.030  rdt0=0  rdt1=0  rdw0=9.3e-6   rdw1=0.06
parameters rdt_eff=(1+  rdt0*delta_t+rdt1*delta_t*delta_t)
parameters rd_weff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
//*rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
parameters rd0rev=210   vgeffrev=2.35   vgmrrev=60   vsmr0rev=1.5   vsmr1rev=0   rdw0rev=1e-5   rdw1rev=0.3
parameters rd_weff_rev=(rdw0rev/wef_res+rdw1rev)*wfac_res 
//*combination
r1 ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res+(rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,n3)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3))),vdeff)/vdmr) * (1+rdb0*v(n4,n3)) * rd_weff) * rdt_eff *drd) *((v(n1,n3)<0)?1:0)+
+  (rdc0*wfac_res+(rd0rev * tanh(pwr(1e-5+abs(v(n2,n1)),vgeffrev)/vgmrrev) * tanh((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3)))/(vsmr0rev * exp(vsmr1rev * v(n2,n1)))) * rd_weff_rev)* drd) * (1-(v(n1,n3)<0)?1:0) 
+     m=multi*nf
pa36_g5b_mac ( n11 n2 n3 n4 ) pa36_g5b  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf  as=as  ps=ps  ad=ad  pd=pd
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=39.6*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 n3 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=39.6*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cbd ( n4 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=39.6*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=39.6*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cb_sub ( n4 sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=39.6*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n4 ) nblpepi_iso_dio area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {
diso1 ( sub n4 ) hvnwnblpsubhvpw_dio_dti_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
}
//***cgb
parameters cgb_c1=-4.99e-10  cgb_c2=4.99e-10  cgb_c3=0.8  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=1.3 
//*.param dcgbp_pa36g5b=1
cgb ( n2 n4 ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n4,n2))+cgb_c2*((v(n4,n2))  - (0.5 * (v(n4,n2)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ - (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*dcgbp_pa36g5b

inline subckt pa45_g5b_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0 sigma=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_hv
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*2.91u/factor+aa*0u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)

+ nbl_area=(bb*3.92u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+2.91u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*7.92u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(bb*3.92u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+2.91u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+wef/factor+2*7.92u/factor)
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_long=20e-6 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_long)?wef:wef_long 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_long)?1:wef_long/wef 
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=20e-6 
parameters lef_res=(lef<=lef_long)?lef:lef_long 
parameters lfac_res=(lef<=lef_long)?1:lef_long/lef 
parameters drd=1+drdp_pa45g5b 
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=25816.9082  rd1=0.1457  vdeff=1.2  vdmr=114  rdb0=0.085   rdw0=1.8214e-05    rdw1=1.0500e-01   rdl0=-1.3909e-07   rdl1=1.3091   rdc0=1
parameters rd_weff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
parameters rd_leff=(rdl0/lef_res+rdl1)*lfac_res 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rd0_rev=750   vgeff_rev=2   vgmr_rev=50   vsmr0_rev=0.75   vsmr1_rev=-0.35   rdw0_rev=2e-5   rdw1_rev=0
parameters rd_weff_rev=(rdw0_rev/wef_res+rdw1_rev)*wfac_res 
//**combination
r1 ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res+(rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,n3)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3))),vdeff)/vdmr) * (1+rdb0*v(n4,n3)) * rd_weff * rd_leff) *drd) *((v(n1,n3)<0)?1:0)+
+  (rdc0*wfac_res+(rd0_rev * tanh(pwr(1e-5+abs(v(n2,n1)),vgeff_rev)/vgmr_rev) * tanh((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3)))/(vsmr0_rev * exp(vsmr1_rev * v(n2,n1)))) * rd_weff_rev)* drd )* (1-
+ (v(n1,n3)<0)?1:0)     m=multi*nf

inline subckt pa55_g5b_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*3.51u/factor+aa*0u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*3.51u/factor+aa*0u/factor)+(nf+aa)*(wef/factor+2*3u/factor)
+ nbl_area=(bb*4.92u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+3.51u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*9.42u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(bb*4.92u/factor+nf*(l+(1.05u+3.51u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+wef/factor+2*9.42u/factor)
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_long=20e-6 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_long)?wef:wef_long 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_long)?1:wef_long/wef 
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=20e-6 
parameters lef_res=(lef<=lef_long)?lef:lef_long 
parameters lfac_res=(lef<=lef_long)?1:lef_long/lef 
parameters drd=1+drdp_pa55g5b 
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=22500  rd1=0.15  vdeff=1.3  vdmr=128  rdb0=2.667e-7   rdb1=0.04667   rdw0=1.733e-5   rdw1=0.1333   rdt0=0   rdt1=0  rdl0=-9.8182e-08    rdl1=1.2182e+00     rdc0=1
parameters rd_weff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
parameters rd_leff=(rdl0/lef_res+rdl1)*lfac_res 
parameters rdb_weff=(rdb0/wef_res+rdb1)*wfac_res 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rd0_rev=700   vgeff_rev=1.22   vgmr_rev=30   vsmr0_rev=1   vsmr1_rev=-0.2   rdw0_rev=4e-5   rdw1_rev=-1
parameters rd_weff_rev=(rdw0_rev/wef_res+rdw1_rev)*wfac_res 
//*************************************************************
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters rdt_eff=(1+  rdt0*delta_t+rdt1*delta_t*delta_t)
//**combination
r1 ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res+ (rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n2,n3)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3))),vdeff)/vdmr) * (1+rdb_weff*v(n4,n3)) * rd_weff *rd_leff* rdt_eff ) 
+ *drd) *((v(n1,n3)<0)?1:0)+ (rdc0*wfac_res+(rd0_rev * tanh(pwr(1e-5+abs(v(n2,n1)),vgeff_rev)/
+ vgmr_rev) * tanh((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n3)))/(vsmr0_rev * exp(vsmr1_rev * v(n2,n1)))) * 
+ rd_weff_rev)* drd )* (1-(v(n1,n3)<0)?1:0)     m=multi*nf
pa55_g5b_mac ( n11 n2 n3 n4 ) pa55_g5b w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf  ad=ad  as=as  pd=pd  ps=ps
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=60.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 n3 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=60.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cbd ( n4 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=60.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=60.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cb_sub ( n4 sub ) capacitor  c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=60.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n4 ) nblpepi_iso_dio area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {
diso1 ( sub n4 ) hvnwnblpsubhvpw_dio_dti_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
}

//*.param cgb_c1 = -3.59e-10 cgb_c2 = 3.59e-10 cgb_c3 = 2.5 cgb_c4 = 0.02 cgb_c5 = 0.8

cgb ( n2 n4 ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n4,n2))+cgb_c2*((v(n4,n2))  - (0.5 * (v(n4,n2)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ - (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+
+ cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n2)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*dcgbp_pa55g5b

parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor

//*******************************************************************************************     
//*                                                                                         *     
//*                      MOS 0.18UM BCD GEN2 NDA45_G3B DEVICE MODELS                        *     
//*                                                                                         *     
//******************************************************************************************* 
inline subckt nda45_g3b_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*(l+(0.54u+5.33u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+
+ 2*7.92u/factor)-(nf*5.33u/factor+bb*2.71u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*(l+(0.54u+5.33u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+
+ 2*7.92u/factor))+(2*(nf*5.33u/factor+bb*2.71u/factor)+(nf+bb)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/
+ factor))
+ nbl_area=(nf*(l+(0.54u+5.33u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u+5.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*13.34u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(nf*(l+(0.54u+5.33u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u+5.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*13.34u/factor))
parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 
parameters wef_extend=20e-6 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nda45g3b 
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=15033  rd1=-0.1458  vdeff=1.35  vdmr=155   rdw0=1.56e-5   rdw1=0.24   rdt0=2e-3  rdt1=-5e-6  rdc0=1
parameters rd_weff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
parameters rdt_eff=(1+rdt0*delta_t+rdt1*delta_t*delta_t) 
//**combination
r1 ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res+(rd0*exp(rd1*v(n2,bs))*tanh(pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/
+ vdmr)*rd_weff)*rdt_eff*drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0)+rdc0*wfac_res*(1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) 
+    m=multi*nf

inline subckt na45_g5b_mac ( n1 n2 n3 n4 sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0 sigma=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_hv
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*(l+(1.05u+5.03u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+
+ 2*7.92u/factor)-(nf*5.03u/factor+bb*2.71u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*(l+(1.05u+5.03u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+
+ 2*7.92u/factor))+(2*(nf*5.03u/factor+bb*2.71u/factor)+(nf+bb)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/
+ factor))
+ nbl_area=(nf*(l+(1.05u+5.03u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u+5.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*13.34u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(nf*(l+(1.05u+5.03u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(2.71u+5.42u+5.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*13.34u/factor))

parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=1  sh_switch=1 
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=2e-005 
parameters lef_short=1.5e-006 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))

parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=4.71e-05   rdw1=-0.9213   rdt1=0   rdt2=0

//**self heating parameter

if (sh_switch==1) {

cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf

grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,n3)) 
} else if (sh_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter
parameters dgid=1+dgidn_na45g5b 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend

+ abs(max(v(n21,n3),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,n3),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,n3)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,n3)-(log(ic0/
+ (1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+abs(max(v(n21,n3),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,n3)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter
parameters cgb_c1=-1.4e-9  cgb_c2=1.4e-9  cgb_c3=0.9  cgb_c4=0.13  cgb_c5=1 
if (cgb_switch==1) {

+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n21,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,n4)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,n4)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_na45g5b
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}
parameters evg_type=1 
parameters evg_peak=9.1 
parameters evg_delta=0.01

+ *sqrt((v(n1,n3)*v(n1,n3))+evg_delta)))))  - evg_type *sqrt( (1.0e-3-(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+
+ v(n2,n3) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,n3)*v(n1,n3))+evg_delta))))) * (1.0e-3-(evg_peak -
+  (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,n3) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,n3)*v(n1,n3))+evg_delta)))))  +  evg_delta 
+ ) )
//**combination

+ abs(v(n1,n3)))/(vsmr0rev * exp(vsmr1rev * v(n21,n1)))) * rdweffrev * drd) * (1-(v(n1,n3)>0)?1:0) 
+ ,1e-2)    m=multi*nf

//**** mismatch ***
parameters
+temp1=par1n_hv  temp2=par2n_hv  temp3=par3n_hv  temp4=par4n_hv  temp5=par5n_hv

//*                              nld55_g5b_mac                                        *

//******************************************************************************************* 
inline subckt nld55_g5b_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*(l+(0.54u+4.73u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(3.21u+6.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*9.42u/factor)-(nf*4.73u/factor+bb*3.21u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*(l+(0.54u+4.73u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(3.21u+6.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+
+ 2*9.42u/factor))+(2*(nf*4.73u/factor+bb*3.21u/factor)+(nf+bb)*(wef/factor+2*3u/factor))
+ nbl_area=(nf*(l+(0.54u+4.73u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(3.21u+6.42u+6.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*15.84u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(nf*(l+(0.54u+4.73u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(3.21u+6.42u+6.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*15.84u/factor))

parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=1  sh_switch=1 
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=6525.4  rd1=-0.0589  vdeff=1.2962  vdmr=101.23 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=1.8148e-005   rdw1=0.241   rdt1=0.0013072   rdt2=1.0000e-006
//*.param rdweff=rdw0*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1))*wfac_res
parameters rdweff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nld55g5b 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=0.006  wrth0=3.4726e-005  k=1.4  rtht1=0.007  cth=1e-012
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (sh_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (sh_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter
//*.param dgid='1+dgidn_nld55g5b'
parameters dgid=1 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub1w0=1.0000e-014  sub1w1=4.5e-020  sub2=6.067  sub3=0.7   sub4=0.001  ibt1=0.00475  ibt2=1e-005  ic0=0.001
if (gid_switch==1) {
gid ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=1*(v(n1,bs)<(log(ic0/(1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,bs)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,bs)-(log(ic0/
+ (1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,bs)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter
parameters cgb_c1=-6.5e-10  cgb_c2=6.5e-10  cgb_c3=0.8  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=0.1 

if (cgb_switch==1) {
cgb ( n21 bs ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n21,bs))+cgb_c2*((v(n21,bs))  + (0.5 * (v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nld55g5b
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}
parameters evg_type=1 
parameters evg_peak=8 
parameters evg_delta=0.01 
evg ( n21 n2 ) bsource  v=0.5  * (  (1.0e-3+(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs)+evg_type 
+ *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  - evg_type *sqrt( (1.0e-3-(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+
+ v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta))))) * (1.0e-3-(evg_peak -
+  (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  +  evg_delta 
+ ) )
//**combination
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=max((rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n21,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdleff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) +
+  rdc0*wfac_res*(1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0),1e-2)    m=multi*nf
nld55_g5b_mac ( n11 n21 bs bs ) nld55_g5b  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf  ad=ad  as=as  pd=pd  ps=ps
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=60.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 bs ) capacitor      c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=60.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

cb_sub ( bs sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=60.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=60.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) nblpepi_iso_dio area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubhvpw_dio_dti_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
}

parameters kf1=1e-30 
parameters af1=0.2 
parameters kffac=kf1*(pwr(abs(nf),(1-af1)))

inline subckt nld65_g5b_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1  dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*(l+(0.54u+5.13u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(3.21u+6.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*9.42u/factor)-(nf*5.13u/factor+bb*3.21u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*(l+(0.54u+5.13u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(3.21u+6.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+
+ 2*9.42u/factor))+(2*(nf*5.13u/factor+bb*3.21u/factor)+(nf+bb)*(wef/factor+2*3u/factor))
+ nbl_area=(nf*(l+(0.54u+5.13u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(3.21u+6.42u+6.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*15.84u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(nf*(l+(0.54u+5.13u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(3.21u+6.42u+6.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*15.84u/factor))

parameters wef=(w/nf)*factor 
parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=1  sh_switch=1 
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=8108.3  rd1=-0.0589  vdeff=1.339  vdmr=114 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=1.723e-005   rdw1=0.10794   rdt1=0.0013072   rdt2=1.0000e-006
parameters rdweff=(rdw0/wef_res+rdw1)*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nld65g5b 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=0.005992  wrth0=3.4726e-005  k=1.4  rtht1=0.007  cth=1e-012
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (sh_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (sh_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter 
parameters dgidn_nld65g5b=0 
parameters dgid=1+dgidn_nld65g5b 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub1w0=1.0000e-014  sub1w1=4.5e-020  sub2=6.067  sub3=0.7   sub4=0.001  ibt1=0.00475  ibt2=1e-005  ic0=0.001
if (gid_switch==1) {
gid ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=1*(v(n1,bs)<(log(ic0/(1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,bs)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,bs)-(log(ic0/
+ (1e-30+sub1weff*pwr((1e-5+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-5+abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,bs)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter 
parameters cgb_c1=-7.10e-10  cgb_c2=7.10e-10  cgb_c3=0.8  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=0.1 
if (cgb_switch==1) {
cgb ( n21 bs ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n21,bs))+cgb_c2*((v(n21,bs))  + (0.5 * (v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nld65g5b
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}
parameters evg_type=1 
parameters evg_peak=7.7 
parameters evg_delta=0.01 
evg ( n21 n2 ) bsource  v=0.5  * (  (1.0e-3+(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs)+evg_type 
+ *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  - evg_type *sqrt( (1.0e-3-(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+
+ v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta))))) * (1.0e-3-(evg_peak -
+  (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  +  evg_delta 
+ ) )
//**combination
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=max((rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n21,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdleff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) +
+  rdc0*wfac_res*(1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0),1e-2)    m=multi*nf
nld65_g5b_mac ( n11 n21 bs bs ) nld65_g5b  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf   as=as  ad=ad  ps=ps  pd=pd
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor    c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=71.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 bs ) capacitor    c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=71.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=71.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cb_sub ( bs sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=71.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

//***** 1/f noise multi modification for fnoimod=0
parameters kf1=1.0e-30 
parameters af1=0.2 
parameters kffac=kf1*(pwr(abs(nf),(1-af1)))

diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubhvpw_dio_65_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {

inline subckt nda65_g3b_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*(l+(0.54u+6.13u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(3.21u+6.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*9.42u/factor)-(nf*6.13u/factor+bb*3.21u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*3u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*(l+(0.54u+6.13u)/factor)+aa*0u/factor+bb*(3.21u+6.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+
+ 2*9.42u/factor))+(2*(nf*6.13u/factor+bb*3.21u/factor)+(nf+bb)*(wef/factor+2*3u/factor))
+ nbl_area=(nf*(l+(0.54u+6.13u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(3.21u+6.42u+6.42u)/factor)*(wef/factor+2*15.84u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*(nf*(l+(0.54u+6.13u)/factor)+aa*(0u+0u)/factor+bb*(3.21u+6.42u+6.42u)/factor+(wef/factor+2*15.84u/factor))

parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_extend=2e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=1  sh_switch=1 
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=2e-005 
parameters lef_short=1.5e-6 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=9586.5  rd1=0  vdeff=1.3054  vdmr=152.23 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=3.621e-005   rdw1=-0.95   rdt1=0.0018   rdt2=0
parameters rdweff=rdw0*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1))*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nda65g3b 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=0.005  wrth0=3.5e-5  k=1.5  rtht1=0.0058  cth=1e-20
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (sh_switch==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (sh_switch==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter 
parameters dgid=1+dgidn_nda65g3b 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub1w0=1e-011  sub1w1=0  sub2=1.2  sub3=3.2   sub4=0.1  ibt1=-0.008  ibt2=0  ic0=1e-3
if (gid_switch==1) {
gid ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=1*(v(n1,bs)<(log(ic0/(sub1weff*pwr((1e-3+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-3+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-3+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-3+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,bs)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,bs)-(log(ic0/
+ (sub1weff*pwr((1e-3+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-3+abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,bs)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter 
parameters cgb_c1=-1.5e-09  cgb_c2=1.5e-09  cgb_c3=1  cgb_c4=0.02  cgb_c5=0.2 
if (cgb_switch==1) {
cgb ( n21 bs ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n21,bs))+cgb_c2*((v(n21,bs))  + (0.5 * (v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nda65g3b
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}
parameters evg_type=1 
parameters evg_peak=12 
parameters evg_delta=0.01 
evg ( n21 n2 ) bsource  v=0.5  * (  (1.0e-3+(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs)+evg_type 
+ *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  - evg_type *sqrt( (1.0e-3-(evg_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+
+ v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta))))) * (1.0e-3-(evg_peak -
+  (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs) +evg_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+evg_delta)))))  +  evg_delta 
+ ) )
//**combination
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n21,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdleff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) +
+  rdc0*wfac_res*(1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0)    m=multi*nf
parameters cjswdn_nda65g3b_din=(cjswdn_nda65g3b*(pd-w))/pd 
parameters jswdn_nda65g3b_din=(7.300e-13*(pd-w)+7.300e-13*w)/pd 

nda65_g3b_mac ( n11 n21 bs bs ) nda65_g3b  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf  as=as  ps=ps  ad=ad  pd=pd
//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=71.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 bs ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=71.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cgs ( n2 bs ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=3.3*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

cb_sub ( bs sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=71.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=71.5*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))


d_din ( bs n1 ) nda65_g3b_din area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi
d_din_g ( bs n1 ) nda65_g3b_din_g area=ad  pj=w  m=multi

if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubhvpw_dio_65_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubhvpw_dio_dti_65_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
}
