inline subckt nld12_g5a_nbl_hp_mac ( n1 n2 bs sub ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1  dti=0
+ as=((wef/factor)*(0.54u/factor)-int((wef-0.94u)/((0.47u+0.94u)))*0.54u/factor*0.47u/factor)*nf/2
+ ps=((0.54u/factor+wef/factor)*2+int((wef-0.94u)/(0.94u+0.47u))*(0.54u/factor-0.47u/factor)*2)*nf/2
+ ad=(0.54u+0u*2)/factor*(wef+0.5u*2)/factor*nf/2
+ pd=(0.54u/factor+0u*2/factor+wef/factor+2*0.5u/factor)*2*nf/2
+ nbl_area=((0.54u/factor+2*l+2*0.63u/factor)*nf/2+2*(0.21u/factor+2u/factor))*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)
+ nbl_pj=2*((0.54u/factor+2*l+2*0.63u/factor)*nf/2+2*(0.21u/factor+2u/factor)+wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)

+area_total=((0.54u/factor+2*l+2*0.63u/factor)*nf/2+2*(0.21u/factor+2u/factor))*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)
parameters area_nf=area_total-(2*(0.21u/factor+2u/factor))*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor) 
parameters area_unit=(0.54u/factor+2*l+2*0.63u/factor)*1/2*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor) 
parameters fn_total=(area_nf/area_unit) 
parameters ad_total=(0.54u+0u*2)/factor*(wef+0.5u*2)/factor*fn_total/2 

parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_extend=5e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=0 
//*sh_switch=1
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=1650  rd1=-0.058  vdeff=1.23  vdmr=90.561 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=6.3617e-5   rdw1=-0.97537   rdt1=0   rdt2=0
parameters rdweff=rdw0*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1))*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nld12g5anblhp 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=9.04e-3  wrth0=7.051e-5  k=1.4  rtht1=8e-3  cth=1e-20
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (shflag_hv==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (shflag_hv==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter 
parameters dgid=1+dgidn_nld12g5anblhp 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub 
parameters sub1w0=1e-018  sub1w1=0  sub2=0  sub3=0   sub4=1  ibt1=0  ibt2=0  ic0=1e-3
if (gid_switch==1) {
gid ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=1*(v(n1,bs)<(log(ic0/(sub1weff*pwr((1e-3+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-3+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/sub4)?  sub1weff*pwr((1e-3+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-3+
+ abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)*exp(v(n1,bs)*sub4):ic0+(sub4*ic0)*(v(n1,bs)-(log(ic0/
+ (sub1weff*pwr((1e-3+abs(v(n1,n11))),sub2)*pwr((1e-3+abs(max(v(n21,bs),0))),sub3)))/
+ sub4)))*ibtemp*wfac_isub*dgid*(v(n1,bs)>0?1:0) m=multi*nf 
} else if (gid_switch==0) {
}
//**Cgb parameter 
parameters cgb_c1=-0.92e-09  cgb_c2=0.92e-09  cgb_c3=0.48  cgb_c4=0.005  cgb_c5=1.36 
if (cgb_switch==1) {
cgb ( n21 bs ) bsource q=(cgb_c1*(v(n21,bs))+cgb_c2*((v(n21,bs))  + (0.5 * (v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))) 
+ + (0.5*cgb_c3*(-1+pwr(1-(4/cgb_c3)*(0.5 *(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4-(pwr((v(n21,bs)+
+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n21,bs)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbn_nld12g5anblhp
} else if (cgb_switch==0) {
}
//**ESOA
parameters  soac1=1.00e-35   soac2=3.27   soac3=-4.530   soac4=1.000   soaic0=0.1217 
if (esoaflag_hv==1) {
gsoa ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(v(n1,bs)  < ((log(soaic0/soac1)+(soac3*v(n21,bs)+soac4))/
+ soac2) ? (soac1*exp(soac2*v(n1,bs)-(soac3*v(n21,bs)+soac4))) : soaic0 + (soac2*soaic0) 
+ * (v(n1,bs) - ((log(soaic0/soac1)+(soac3*v(n21,bs)+soac4))/soac2)))  m=multi*nf 
} else if (esoaflag_hv==0) {
}
//**Combination 
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n21,bs)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,bs))),vdeff)/vdmr) * rdweff * rdleff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0) +
+  rdc0*wfac_res*(1-(v(n1,bs)>0)?1:0)    m=multi*nf

parameters cjswdn_nld12g5anblhp_din=(cjswdn_nld12g5anblhp*(pd-w))/pd 
parameters jswdn_nld12g5anblhp_din=(1.350e-12*(pd-w)+3.040e-13*w)/pd 

nld12_g5a_nbl_hp_mac ( n11 n21 bs bs ) nld12_g5a_nbl_hp  w=w  l=l  m=multi  nf=nf   as=as  ad=ad  ps=ps  pd=pd

parameters _type=1 
parameters _peak=10 
parameters _delta=0.01 

evb ( n21 n2 ) bsource  v=0.5  * (  (1.0e-3+(_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+v(n2,bs)+_type 
+ *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+_delta)))))  - _type *sqrt( (1.0e-3-(_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+
+ v(n2,bs) +_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+_delta))))) * (1.0e-3-(_peak - (0.5*(v(n2,n1)+
+ v(n2,bs) +_type *sqrt((v(n1,bs)*v(n1,bs))+_delta)))))  +  _delta ) )

//**** parasitic c for soa check
cgd ( n2 n1 ) capacitor   c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=13.2*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cds ( n1 bs ) capacitor      c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=13.2*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

cb_sub ( bs sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=13.2*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))
cd_sub ( n1 sub ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=multi  bv_max=13.2*(max(ov_ratio_hv/1.1,1))

d_din ( bs n1 ) nld12_g5a_nbl_hp_din area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi
d_din_g ( bs n1 ) nld12_g5a_nbl_hp_din_g area=ad  pj=w  m=multi

if (dti==0) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
} else if (dti==1) {
diso1 ( sub n1 ) hvnwnblpsubshp_dio_dti_iso area=nbl_area  pj=nbl_pj  m=multi
}
//*** DRR ***
//************ DRR ***********
//*Diode Reverse Recovery Parameter
//*****************************
parameters tre=max(min(max(5e-005*pwr(ad_total*factor*factor,5.8e-4)-4.9431e-5,5e-009),5e-008)*(1+(min(max(-2.70311e+005*ad_total*factor*factor-9.95643e-004,-5.61e-003),-2.22e-003))*(temp-25)),5e-009) 
parameters sofre=0.15 
parameters cap_drr=1u 

if (drrflag_hv==1) {
d_din_dc ( bs_1 n1 ) nld12_g5a_nbl_hp_din_dc area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi

//*****************************
//*drain to source
//*****************************
vdio_1 ( bs bs_1 ) vsource dc=0
fis_qrr ( bs n1 ) cccs probe=vtmp gain=-1
hqs1_qrr ( qs1a_1 qs2a ) ccvs probe=vdio_1 rm=tre/cap_drr
vtmp ( qs1a qs1a_1 ) vsource dc=0
hqs2_qrr ( qs2a 0 ) ccvs probe=vtmp rm=tre*sofre/cap_drr
cs_qrr ( qs1a 0 ) capacitor       c=cap_drr 

} else if (drrflag_hv==0) {
d_din_dc ( bs n1 ) nld12_g5a_nbl_hp_din_dc area=ad  pj=pd  m=multi
}

parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_hv sigma=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.48u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*1.13u/factor+aa*0u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*1u/factor)

parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 



parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_extend=5e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters drd=1+drdp_pa12g5anblmr 
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=7300  rd1=0.1692  vdeff=1.40  vdmr=162  rdb0=0.06887668193   rdw0=3.10e-5   rdw1=-1.039   rdt1=0   rdt2=0
parameters rdweff=rdw0*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1))*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rd0rev=72.859   vgeffrev=1.68   vgmrrev=37.52   vsmr0rev=0.2858   vsmr1rev=-0.3105   rdw0rev=4.896e-005   rdw1rev=-0.99658
parameters rdweffrev=rdw0rev*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1rev))*wfac_res 
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=7.45e-3  wrth0=9.55e-5  k=1.5  rtht1=0  cth=1e-020
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
//**combination
rdmacro ( n1 n11 ) resistor r=(rdc0*wfac_res + rd0 * exp (rd1* v(n21,n3)) * tanh(pwr((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3))),vdeff)/vdmr) * (1+rdb0*v(n4,n3)) * rdweff * rdtemp *drd)*((v(n1,n3)<0)?1:0) 
+ + (rdc0*wfac_res + rd0rev * tanh(pwr(1e-5+abs(v(n21,n1)),vgeffrev)/vgmrrev) * tanh((1e-5+
+ abs(v(n1,n3)))/(vsmr0rev * exp(vsmr1rev * v(n21,n1)))) * rdweffrev * drd) * (1-(v(n1,n3)<0)?1:0) 
+     m=multi*nf

if (shflag_hv==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf

} else if (shflag_hv==0) {

+ cgb_c5+cgb_c4)*(v(n4,n21)+cgb_c5+cgb_c4)+4*cgb_c4 ,0.5)))),0.5)))))*w*factor*multi*cgbp_pa12g5anblmr

parameters
+temp1=par1p_hv  temp2=par2p_hv  temp3=par3p_hv  temp4=par4p_hv  temp5=par5p_hv 


+mis_a_1=-0.01*1.414  mis_a_2=-0.04  mis_a_3=0.072

+mis_f_1=-0.07*1.414  mis_f_2=-0.2  mis_f_3=0.2 



+a=mis_a_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_a_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_a_3) 
+b=mis_b_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_b_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_b_3) 
+c=mis_c_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_c_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_c_3) 
+d=mis_d_1*pwr(abs(lef*1e6),mis_d_2)*pwr(abs(wef*1e6),mis_d_3)

+fac1=temp1 
+fac2=temp2 
+fac3=temp3 
+fac4=temp4 
+fac5=c*temp4+sqrt(1-c*c)*temp5

inline subckt nld36_g5a_mac ( n1 n2 bs ) 
parameters l=length w=width multi=1 nf=1 factor=1 dti=0
+ as=(wef/factor)*(0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ps=2*(wef/factor+0.32u/factor)*nf
+ ad=(nf*3.83u/factor+bb*2.71u/factor)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)
+ pd=2*(nf*3.83u/factor+bb*2.71u/factor)+(nf+bb)*(wef/factor+2*2.5u/factor)

parameters aa=nf-int(nf/2)*2 
parameters bb=2-nf+int(nf/2)*2 

parameters wef=w/nf*factor 
parameters wef_extend=5e-005 
parameters wef_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_res=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef_extend/wef 
parameters delta_t=temp-25 
parameters cgb_switch=1  gid_switch=0 
//*sh_switch=1
//**rd ldep parameter
parameters lef=l*factor 
parameters lef_long=1e-010 
parameters lef_short=0 
parameters rdl0=0 
parameters rdleff=((1-rdl0)  +rdl0*((lef>lef_long)?lef_short/lef_long:lef_short/lef))
//**rd forward parameter
parameters rd0=2824.5  rd1=-0.1  vdeff=1.24  vdmr=100 
parameters rdb0=0   rdw0=9.9939e-005  rdw1=-0.93122  rdt1=0.001   rdt2=0
parameters rdweff=rdw0*(pwr(wef_res,rdw1))*wfac_res 
parameters rdtemp=(1+rdt1*delta_t+rdt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters drd=1+drdn_nld36g5a 
//**rd reverse parameter
parameters rdc0=1 
//**self heating parameter
parameters rth0=0.007813  wrth0=4.102e-005   k=1.4  rtht1=7.5e-3  cth=1e-20
parameters tempk=temp+273 
parameters rthtemp=(1+rtht1*delta_t) 
parameters rth=rth0/(wef+wrth0)*rthtemp 
if (shflag_hv==1) {
rth ( t1 0 ) resistor r=rth  m=multi*nf
cth ( t1 0 ) capacitor c=cth  m=multi*nf 
grth1 ( n1 bs ) bsource  i=(pwr(((v(t1,0)+tempk)/tempk),-k)-1)*i(rdmacro) 
grth2 ( 0 t1 ) bsource  i=abs(i(rdmacro)*v(n1,bs)) 
} else if (shflag_hv==0) {
}
//**Gid parameter
parameters dgid=1+dgidn_nld36g5a 
parameters wef_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?wef:wef_extend 
parameters wfac_isub=(wef<=wef_extend)?1:wef/wef_extend 
parameters ibtemp=(1+ibt1*delta_t+ibt2*delta_t*delta_t) 
parameters sub1weff=sub1w0+sub1w1/wef_isub

section dio_sbd_zd

// ****************************************************************************
//    
//  CMOS 0.18um 5V Schottky Barrier Diode (SBD) Scalable Model
// 
//  HSPICE :
//   
//      ## library files:
//         Model Name     Length, l(um)    Width, w(um)     Finger Number, nf
//         --------------------------------------------------------------------
//         ndio_sbd_mac   1 ~ 4            1 ~ 16             1 ~ 16
// 
// ****************************************************************************
// ****************************************************************************
// ****                 5V Schottky Diode                                 *****
// ****************************************************************************
subckt ndio_sbd_mac ( n1 n2 ) 
parameters l=1e-006 w=16e-006 nf=16 multi=1 factor=1

parameters lum=l*factor*1e6 
parameters wum=w*factor*1e6 

parameters a1_eff=multi*(l*w*nf) 
parameters p1_eff=multi*((l+w)*2*nf) 

parameters is=(-1.3040411)*lum+(-1.1959868)*wum+(-0.0023183)*nf+(-0.0321603)*lum*wum+(-0.0173839)*lum*nf+(-0.0055588)*wum*nf+(-0.0005590)*lum*wum*nf+(7.58829237)*sqrt(lum*wum)+(0.02794188)*sqrt(lum*wum)*nf+(-4.0931213)

//**************************** n+ od w/i silicide w>2um resistor model ***********************************
subckt rnod ( n1 n2 ) 
parameters l=length w=width factor=1 mf=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_res
parameters geo_fac=1/sqrt(mf*l*factor*w*factor*1e12) 
parameters factmis=0.01142*geo_fac*par_res*mismatchflag 
parameters rsh=r_rnod*(1+factmis) 
parameters dw=-0.0858u 
parameters pvc2w=2.38e-013*(min(w*factor*1e6,  10))*(min(w*factor*1e6, 10))-1.50e-13*(min(w*factor*1e6, 10))+7.45e-12
parameters ptc1=3.35e-3  ptc2=4.31e-7  pvc1=4.19e-08  pvc2=pvc2w*(1.0-7.78e-03*(pt-25.0)+5.23e-05*(pt-25.0)*(pt-25.0)) 
parameters pt=temp 
parameters tfac=1.0+ptc1*(pt-25.0)+ptc2*(pt-25.0)*(pt-25.0) 
parameters rmain=rsh/mf*l*factor/(w*factor-dw)*tfac 

parameters j_max=6000 
parameters r1_ov=max(min(rmain*(1+pvc1*(0/l/factor)+pvc2*(0/l/factor)*(0/l/factor)),  rmain*1.5), rmain/2)

r1 ( n1 n2 ) resistor r=max(min(rmain*(1+pvc1*(abs(v(n2,n1))/l/factor)+pvc2*(v(n2,n1)/l/factor)*(v(n2,n1)/l/factor)), rmain*1.5), rmain/2)
c_soa ( n1 n2 ) capacitor c=1e-60  m=mf bv_max=j_max*w*factor*r1_ov

ends rnod

parameters pvc1=(2.293e-08/(max(w*factor*1e6,  1.8))+1.259e-09)*(min(l*factor*1e6, 100))+(-5.381e-08/(max(w*factor*1e6, 1.8))+6.448e-08)   pvc2=0 
parameters ptc1=2.61e-03    ptc2=8.2e-06 
parameters tfac=1.0+ptc1*(pt-25.0)+ptc2*(pt-25.0)*(pt-25.0) 
parameters rmain=rsh/mf*l*factor/(w*factor-dw)*tfac 
parameters rend=rend_rnwod_pure5v*(1+factmis) 

parameters j_max=500 
parameters rn1_ov=rend/mf/(w*factor+0.5u) 
parameters r1_ov=max(min(rmain*(1+pvc1*(0/l/factor)+pvc2*(0/l/factor)*(0/l/factor)),  rmain*1.5), rmain/2)
parameters rn2_ov=rend/mf/(w*factor+0.5u) 

rn1 ( n1 1 ) resistor r=rend/mf/(w*factor+0.5u)
r1 ( 1 2 ) resistor r=max(min(rmain*(1+pvc1*(abs(v(2,1))/l/factor)+pvc2*(v(2,1)/l/factor)*(v(2,1)/l/factor)), rmain*1.5), rmain/2)
rn2 ( 2 n2 ) resistor r=rend/mf/(w*factor+0.5u)
c_soa ( n1 n2 ) capacitor c=1e-60  m=mf bv_max=j_max*w*factor*(rn1_ov+r1_ov+rn2_ov)

ends rnwod_pure5v

endsection res

section disres
//*************************************
//*       3t resister model           *
//*************************************

subckt rnod_m ( n1 n2 body ) 
parameters lr=length wr=width mf=1 factor=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_disres
parameters geo_fac=1/sqrt(mf*lr*factor*wr*factor*1e12) 
parameters factmis=0.01142*geo_fac*par_res_dis*mismatchflag 
parameters rsh=r_rnod_dis*(1+factmis)/4 
parameters dw=-0.0858u 
parameters pvc2w=2.38e-013*(min(wr*factor*1e6,  10))*(min(wr*factor*1e6, 10))-1.50e-13*(min(wr*factor*1e6, 10))+7.45e-12
parameters ptc1=3.35e-3  ptc2=4.31e-7  pvc1=4.19e-08  pvc2=pvc2w*(1.0-7.78e-03*(pt-25.0)+5.23e-05*(pt-25.0)*(pt-25.0)) 
parameters pt=temp 
parameters tfac=1.0+ptc1*(pt-25.0)+ptc2*(pt-25.0)*(pt-25) 
parameters rmain=rsh/mf*lr*factor/(wr*factor-dw)*tfac 

parameters j_max=6000 
parameters r1_ov=max(min(rmain*(1+pvc1*(0/lr/factor)+pvc2*(0/lr/factor)*(0/lr/factor)),  rmain*1.5), rmain/2)
parameters r2_ov=max(min(rmain*(1+pvc1*(0/lr/factor)+pvc2*(0/lr/factor)*(0/lr/factor)),  rmain*1.5), rmain/2)
parameters r3_ov=max(min(rmain*(1+pvc1*(0/lr/factor)+pvc2*(0/lr/factor)*(0/lr/factor)),  rmain*1.5), rmain/2)
parameters r4_ov=max(min(rmain*(1+pvc1*(0/lr/factor)+pvc2*(0/lr/factor)*(0/lr/factor)),  rmain*1.5), rmain/2)

r1 ( n1 nm ) resistor r=max(min(rmain*(1+pvc1*(abs(v(n2,n1))/lr/factor)+pvc2*(v(n2,n1)/lr/factor)*(v(n2,n1)/lr/factor)), rmain*1.5), rmain/2)

//**************************** P- Poly w/o silicide 2um<W ***********************************
subckt rppolyhri_dis ( n1 n2 body ) 
parameters lr=length wr=width factor=1 mf=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_disres
parameters geo_fac=1/sqrt(mf*lr*factor*wr*factor*1e12) 
parameters factmis=0.00964*geo_fac*par_res_dis*mismatchflag 
parameters rsh=r_rppolyhri_dis/4*(1+factmis)   rendsh=rend_rppolyhri_dis*1e6*(1+factmis)
parameters dw_etch=0u-3.9286e-08*(pwr(0.44,x_dxw_rppolyhri_dis)-1) 
parameters dw_emp=6.5410714883522e-08  dw_empend=7.410714883522e-10 
parameters dl_etch=0 
parameters dw=(dw_etch+dw_emp)*1e6   dwend=(dw_etch+dw_empend)*1e6 
parameters dl=(dl_etch+dxl_rppolyhri_dis)*1e6 
parameters jc1_0=0.1474037106889946   jc1_w=0.0400847859662231   jc1_n=0.000964257603206478
parameters jc1end_0=5.878327431421787   jc1end_w=2.65607312261631 
parameters tc1_0=-0.00103412157111652   tc1_w=1.10638460995948e-05 
parameters tc2_0=2.50172779429575e-06   tc2_w=-7.29824957952402e-08 
parameters tc1end_0=-0.000530197650596438   tc1end_w=-0.000148415177260185 
parameters tc2end_0=-1.40888462983242e-06   tc2end_w=8.23396549335135e-07 
parameters jct_0=-0.00341305960400095   jct_w=5.19508920284451e-05 
parameters jctend_0=-0.00469373756335246   jctend_w=0.00101066163029796 
parameters delta_t=temp  - 25
parameters lum=lr*factor*1e6    wum=wr*factor*1e6    nsqr=lr/wr
parameters tc1=tc1_0  + tc1_w * min(wum, 10)   tc2=tc2_0  + tc2_w * min(wum, 10)
parameters tc1end=tc1end_0  + tc1end_w * min(wum, 10)   tc2end=tc2end_0  + tc2end_w * min(wum, 10)
parameters jct=jct_0  + jct_w * min(wum, 10)
parameters jctend=jctend_0  + jctend_w * min(wum, 10)
parameters jc1=(jc1_0  + jc1_w * min(wum, 10) + jc1_n * min(nsqr, 20)) * (1 + jct * delta_t) / (lum-dl) / (lum-dl)
parameters jc1_r=jc1*16 
parameters jc1end=max(0,  (jc1end_0 + jc1end_w * min(wum, 10)) * (1 + jctend * delta_t))
parameters jc1end_r=jc1end*4 
parameters tfac=1  + tc1 * delta_t + tc2 * delta_t * delta_t
parameters tfacend=1  + tc1end * delta_t + tc2end * delta_t * delta_t
parameters rendo=rendsh/mf/(wum-dwend)*tfacend 
parameters ro=rsh/mf*(lum-dl)/(wum-dw)*tfac 
parameters ca=ca_pofox_r  cf=cf_polfox_r 
parameters jcb_0=4.5e-5 
parameters jcb_w=5.25e-5 
parameters jcb_l=-0.6333e-4 

parameters j_max=500 
parameters rend1_ov=max(min(rendo/2*(3-1/(1+jc1end_r*0*0)),  rendo*1.5), rendo/2)
parameters r1_ov=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*0*0))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((0)+(0))),  ro*1.5), ro/2)
parameters r2_ov=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*0*0))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((0)+(0))),  ro*1.5), ro/2)
parameters r3_ov=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*0*0))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((0)+(0))),  ro*1.5), ro/2)
parameters r4_ov=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*0*0))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((0)+(0))),  ro*1.5), ro/2)
parameters rend2_ov=max(min(rendo/2*(3-1/(1+jc1end_r*0*0)),  rendo*1.5), rendo/2)

rend1 ( n2 ns ) resistor r=max(min(rendo/2*(3-1/(1+jc1end_r*v(n2,ns)*v(n2,ns))), rendo*1.5), rendo/2)
r1 ( ns nm ) resistor r=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*v(ns,nm)*v(ns,nm)))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((v(body)-v(n1))+(v(body)-v(n2)))), ro*1.5), ro/2)
r2 ( nm nn ) resistor r=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*v(nm,nn)*v(nm,nn)))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((v(body)-v(n1))+(v(body)-v(n2)))), ro*1.5), ro/2)
r3 ( nn nx ) resistor r=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*v(nn,nx)*v(nn,nx)))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((v(body)-v(n1))+(v(body)-v(n2)))), ro*1.5), ro/2)
r4 ( nx ne ) resistor r=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*v(nx,ne)*v(nx,ne)))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((v(body)-v(n1))+(v(body)-v(n2)))), ro*1.5), ro/2)
rend2 ( ne n1 ) resistor r=max(min(rendo/2*(3-1/(1+jc1end_r*v(ne,n1)*v(ne,n1))), rendo*1.5), rendo/2)
c1 ( body n1 ) capacitor c=mf*(ca*((wr*factor-0.02u)*lr*factor/5.0)*1e12+2*cf*lr*factor/5.0*1e6) bv_max=100*0.9 
c2 ( body nm ) capacitor c=mf*(ca*((wr*factor-0.02u)*lr*factor/5.0)*1e12+2*cf*lr*factor/5.0*1e6) bv_max=100*0.9 
c3 ( body nn ) capacitor c=mf*(ca*((wr*factor-0.02u)*lr*factor/5.0)*1e12+2*cf*lr*factor/5.0*1e6) bv_max=100*0.9 
c4 ( body nx ) capacitor c=mf*(ca*((wr*factor-0.02u)*lr*factor/5.0)*1e12+2*cf*lr*factor/5.0*1e6) bv_max=100*0.9 
c5 ( body n2 ) capacitor c=mf*(ca*((wr*factor-0.02u)*lr*factor/5.0)*1e12+2*cf*lr*factor/5.0*1e6) bv_max=100*0.9 
c_soa ( n1 n2 ) capacitor c=1e-60  m=mf bv_max=j_max*wr*factor*(rend1_ov+r1_ov+r2_ov+r3_ov+r4_ov+rend2_ov)

ends rppolyhri_dis

//***********************************     P-POLY w/o silicide resistor     ***********************************
subckt rppolyhri3k_dis ( n1 n2 body ) 
parameters lr=length wr=width mf=1 factor=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_disres
parameters geo_fac=1/sqrt(mf*lr*factor*wr*factor*1e12) 
parameters factmis=0.0180*geo_fac*par_res_dis*mismatchflag 
parameters rsh=r_rppolyhri3k_dis/4*(1+factmis)   rendsh=rend_rppolyhri3k_dis/2*1e6*(1+factmis)
parameters dw=7.3e-02  + (-3.5315e-08*(pwr(0.30625,x_dxw_rppolyhri3k_dis)-1))*1e6  dwend=0   dl=1.50e-01  + (-1.8e-7*(pwr(1.1111,x_dxl_rppolyhri3k_dis)-1))*1e6
parameters jc1_0=0.0284541776598384    jc1_w=0.0552178046415412*1.2        jc1_n=0.000714344378379032*2.5
parameters jc1end_0=0   jc1end_w=0 
parameters tc1_0=-0.002016610001954663   tc1_w=1.80006103761493e-05 
parameters tc2_0=5.06026391020496e-06   tc2_w=-1.21111777945279e-07 
parameters tc1end_0=0   tc1end_w=0 
parameters tc2end_0=0   tc2end_w=0 
parameters jct_0=-0.00386214585793815   jct_w=0.00019185053193552 
parameters jctend_0=0   jctend_w=0 
parameters delta_t=temp  - 25
parameters lum=lr*factor*1e6    wum=wr*factor*1e6    nsqr=lr/wr
parameters tc1=tc1_0  + tc1_w * wum   tc2=tc2_0  + tc2_w * wum
parameters tc1end=tc1end_0  + tc1end_w * wum   tc2end=tc2end_0  + tc2end_w * wum
parameters jct=jct_0  + jct_w * wum
parameters jctend=jctend_0  + jctend_w * wum
parameters jc1=max(0,  (jc1_0 + jc1_w * wum + jc1_n * nsqr) * (1 + jct * delta_t) / (lum-dl) / (lum-dl))
parameters jc1_r=jc1*16  jc1end_r=jc1end*4 
parameters jc1end=max(0,  (jc1end_0 + jc1end_w * wum) * (1 + jctend * delta_t))
parameters tfac=1  + tc1 * delta_t + tc2 * delta_t * delta_t
parameters tfacend=1  + tc1end * delta_t + tc2end * delta_t * delta_t
parameters rendo=rendsh/mf/(wum-dwend)*tfacend 
parameters ro=rsh/mf*(lum-dl)/(wum-dw)*tfac 
parameters ca=ca_pofox_r  cf=cf_polfox_r 
parameters jcb_0=8e-5 
parameters jcb_w=10.5e-5 
parameters jcb_l=-1.35e-4 

parameters j_max=500 
parameters rend1_ov=max(min(rendo/2*(3-1/(1+jc1end_r*0*0)),  rendo*1.5), rendo/5)
parameters r1_ov=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*0*0))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((0)+(0))),  ro*1.5), ro/5)
parameters r2_ov=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*0*0))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((0)+(0))),  ro*1.5), ro/5)
parameters r3_ov=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*0*0))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((0)+(0))),  ro*1.5), ro/5)
parameters r4_ov=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*0*0))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((0)+(0))),  ro*1.5), ro/5)
parameters rend2_ov=max(min(rendo/2*(3-1/(1+jc1end_r*0*0)),  rendo*1.5), rendo/5)

rend1 ( n2 ns ) resistor r=max(min(rendo/2*(3-1/(1+jc1end_r*v(n2,ns)*v(n2,ns))), rendo*1.5), rendo/5)
r1 ( ns nm ) resistor r=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*v(ns,nm)*v(ns,nm)))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((v(body)-v(n1))+(v(body)-v(n2)))), ro*1.5), ro/5)
r2 ( nm nn ) resistor r=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*v(nm,nn)*v(nm,nn)))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((v(body)-v(n1))+(v(body)-v(n2)))), ro*1.5), ro/5)
r3 ( nn nx ) resistor r=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*v(nn,nx)*v(nn,nx)))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((v(body)-v(n1))+(v(body)-v(n2)))), ro*1.5), ro/5)
r4 ( nx ne ) resistor r=max(min(ro/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r*v(nx,ne)*v(nx,ne)))*(1+(jcb_0+jcb_w*1/wum+jcb_l*1/lum)*((v(body)-v(n1))+(v(body)-v(n2)))), ro*1.5), ro/5)
rend2 ( ne n1 ) resistor r=max(min(rendo/2*(3-1/(1+jc1end_r*v(ne,n1)*v(ne,n1))), rendo*1.5), rendo/5)
c1 ( body n1 ) capacitor c=mf*(ca*((wr*factor-0.02u)*lr*factor/5.0)*1e12+2*cf*lr*factor/5.0*1e6) bv_max=100*0.9 
c2 ( body nm ) capacitor c=mf*(ca*((wr*factor-0.02u)*lr*factor/5.0)*1e12+2*cf*lr*factor/5.0*1e6) bv_max=100*0.9 
c3 ( body nn ) capacitor c=mf*(ca*((wr*factor-0.02u)*lr*factor/5.0)*1e12+2*cf*lr*factor/5.0*1e6) bv_max=100*0.9 
c4 ( body nx ) capacitor c=mf*(ca*((wr*factor-0.02u)*lr*factor/5.0)*1e12+2*cf*lr*factor/5.0*1e6) bv_max=100*0.9 
c5 ( body n2 ) capacitor c=mf*(ca*((wr*factor-0.02u)*lr*factor/5.0)*1e12+2*cf*lr*factor/5.0*1e6) bv_max=100*0.9 
c_soa ( n1 n2 ) capacitor c=1e-60  m=mf bv_max=j_max*wr*factor*(rend1_ov+r1_ov+r2_ov+r3_ov+r4_ov+rend2_ov)

ends rppolyhri3k_dis

//**************************** N+ OD w/o silicide 2um<=W (pure5V)***********************************
subckt rnodrpo_pure5v_m ( n1 n2 body ) 
parameters lr=length wr=width factor=1 mf=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_disres
parameters geo_fac=1/sqrt(mf*lr*factor*wr*factor*1e12) 
parameters factmis=0.0345*geo_fac*par_res_dis*mismatchflag 
parameters rsh=r_nodrpo_pure5v_dis/4*(1+factmis)   rendsh=rend_nodrpo_pure5v_dis*1e6*(1+factmis)
parameters dw_etch=0u-2.3333e-07*(pwr(0.7,x_dxw_nodrpo_pure5v_dis)-1) 
parameters dw_emp=-7.04e-08    dw_empend=-1.29859012784265e-07 
parameters dl_etch=0 
parameters dw=(dw_etch+dw_emp)*1e6 
parameters dwend=(dw_etch+dw_empend)*1e6 
parameters dl=(dl_etch+dxl_nodrpo_pure5v_dis)*1e6 
parameters jc1_0=0.26049641179018   jc1_w=0.338753336333001   jc1_n=0.0115470183520801
parameters jc1end_0=0.482123799537825   jc1end_w=0.0465075945675371 
parameters tc1_0=0.00163760188660371   tc1_w=4.869908308429e-06 
parameters tc2_0=-5.1547590573148e-07   tc2_w=-1.66380122167674e-08 
parameters tc1end_0=0.000678492619996571   tc1end_w=0.00013178484793306 
parameters tc2end_0=-1.88756918539424e-07   tc2end_w=-7.42454642097019e-07 
parameters jct_0=-0.000221973003336103   jct_w=0.000308757232255487 
parameters jctend_0=-0.0523812972984853   jctend_w=0.076695898710281 
parameters delta_t=temp  - 25
parameters lum=lr*factor*1e6    wum=wr*factor*1e6    nsqr=lr/wr
parameters tc1=tc1_0  + tc1_w * min(wum, 10)   tc2=tc2_0  + tc2_w * min(wum, 10)
parameters tc1end=tc1end_0  + tc1end_w * min(wum, 10)   tc2end=tc2end_0  + tc2end_w * min(wum, 10)
parameters jct=jct_0  + jct_w * min(wum, 10)
parameters jctend=jctend_0  + jctend_w * min(wum, 10)
parameters jc1=max(0,  (jc1_0 + jc1_w * min(wum, 10) + jc1_n * min(nsqr, 73)) * (1 + jct * delta_t) / (lum-dl) / (lum-dl))
parameters jc1_r=jc1*16 
parameters jc1end=max(0,  (jc1end_0 + jc1end_w * min(wum, 10)) * (1 + jctend * delta_t))
parameters jc1end_r=jc1end*4 
parameters tfac=1  + tc1 * delta_t + tc2 * delta_t * delta_t
parameters tfacend=1  + tc1end * delta_t + tc2end * delta_t * delta_t
parameters rendo=rendsh/mf/(wum-dwend)*tfacend 
parameters ro=rsh/mf*(lum-dl)/(wum-dw)*tfac 

parameters j_max=500 
parameters rend1_ov=max(min(rendo/2*(1+1/(1+jc1end_r*0*0)),  rendo*1.5), rendo/2)
parameters r1_ov=max(min(ro/2*(3-1/(1+jc1_r*0*0)),  ro*1.5), ro/2)
parameters r2_ov=max(min(ro/2*(3-1/(1+jc1_r*0*0)),  ro*1.5), ro/2)
parameters r3_ov=max(min(ro/2*(3-1/(1+jc1_r*0*0)),  ro*1.5), ro/2)
parameters r4_ov=max(min(ro/2*(3-1/(1+jc1_r*0*0)),  ro*1.5), ro/2)
parameters rend2_ov=max(min(rendo/2*(1+1/(1+jc1end_r*0*0)),  rendo*1.5), rendo/2)

rend1 ( n2 ns ) resistor r=max(min(rendo/2*(1+1/(1+jc1end_r*v(n2,ns)*v(n2,ns))), rendo*1.5), rendo/2)
r1 ( ns nm ) resistor r=max(min(ro/2*(3-1/(1+jc1_r*v(ns,nm)*v(ns,nm))), ro*1.5), ro/2)
r2 ( nm nn ) resistor r=max(min(ro/2*(3-1/(1+jc1_r*v(nm,nn)*v(nm,nn))), ro*1.5), ro/2)
r3 ( nn nx ) resistor r=max(min(ro/2*(3-1/(1+jc1_r*v(nn,nx)*v(nn,nx))), ro*1.5), ro/2)
r4 ( nx ne ) resistor r=max(min(ro/2*(3-1/(1+jc1_r*v(nx,ne)*v(nx,ne))), ro*1.5), ro/2)
rend2 ( ne n1 ) resistor r=max(min(rendo/2*(1+1/(1+jc1end_r*v(ne,n1)*v(ne,n1))), rendo*1.5), rendo/2)
d1 ( body ns ) ndio_5 area=mf*((wr-dw/factor*1e-6)*(lr-dl/factor*1e-6)/5.0)  pj=mf*((wr-dw/factor*1e-6)+2.0*(lr-dl/factor*1e-6)/5.0) 
d2 ( body nm ) ndio_5 area=mf*((wr-dw/factor*1e-6)*(lr-dl/factor*1e-6)/5.0)  pj=mf*(2.0*(lr-dl/factor*1e-6)/5.0) 
d3 ( body nn ) ndio_5 area=mf*((wr-dw/factor*1e-6)*(lr-dl/factor*1e-6)/5.0)  pj=mf*(2.0*(lr-dl/factor*1e-6)/5.0) 
d4 ( body nx ) ndio_5 area=mf*((wr-dw/factor*1e-6)*(lr-dl/factor*1e-6)/5.0)  pj=mf*(2.0*(lr-dl/factor*1e-6)/5.0) 
d5 ( body ne ) ndio_5 area=mf*((wr-dw/factor*1e-6)*(lr-dl/factor*1e-6)/5.0)  pj=mf*((wr-dw/factor*1e-6)+2.0*(lr-dl/factor*1e-6)/5.0) 
c_soa ( n1 n2 ) capacitor c=1e-60  m=mf bv_max=j_max*wr*factor*(rend1_ov+r1_ov+r2_ov+r3_ov+r4_ov+rend2_ov)

ends rnodrpo_pure5v_m

parameters tfacend=1  + tc1end * delta_t + tc2end * delta_t * delta_t
parameters rendo=rendsh/mf/(wum-dwend)*tfacend 
parameters ro=(rsh/mf*(lum-dl)/(wum-dw)*tfac)/10 
parameters ca=ca_pofox_r      cf=cf_polfox_r 
parameters jcb_0=2.55e-5 
parameters jcb_w=2.55e-5 
parameters jcb_l=1.4e-3 

parameters j_max=500 
parameters rend1_ov=max(min(rendo/2*(3-1/(1+jc1end_r*0*0)),  rendo*1.5), rendo/2)

parameters r2_ov=max(min(ro*2/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r2*0*0)),  ro*1.5), ro/2)
parameters r3_ov=max(min(ro*2/2*(1+1/(1+jc1_r2*0*0)),  ro*1.5), ro/2)

c1 ( body 2 ) capacitor c= mf*(ca*((wr*factor)*lr*factor/5.0)*1e12+2*cf*lr*factor/5.0*1e6) bv_max=100*0.9

+ v(n2)))+vcd_fac*abs(v(1)-v(2))))

+ * wr * factor * mr dt=temp - 25 cgmin=(3.727e-10 * pj + 2.008e-03 * area) *

section mim
// *************************************************************************************************
//  2) MIM BaseBand CAPACITOR MODEL :
// 
// 
//      ## library files:
//      
//      1. The BB 1.0fF MIM capacitors without Shield are modeled with 2T sub-circuit 
//  'mimcap_1p0_sin'      
// 
//       .subckt mimcap_1p0_sin : Typical model,  
// 
//      2. The BB 1.0fF MIM capacitors without Shield are modeled with 3T sub-circuit 
//  'mimcap_1p0_sin_3t'      
// 
//       .subckt mimcap_1p0_sin_3t : Typical model,  
//      
//      3. The BB 2.0fF MIM capacitors without Shield are modeled with 2T sub-circuit 
//  'mimcap_2p0_sin'      
// 
//       .subckt mimcap_2p0_sin : Typical model,  
// 
//      4. The BB 2.0fF MIM capacitors without Shield are modeled with 3T sub-circuit 
//  'mimcap_2p0_sin_3t'      
// 
//       .subckt mimcap_2p0_sin_3t : Typical model,  
//       
//       
//             Model name                     lt                wt          unit
//                                        low    high       low    high
//             -------------------------------------------------------------------
//             mimcap_1p0_sin              4      30         4      30       um
//             mimcap_1p0_sin_3t           4      30         4      30       um
//             mimcap_2p0_sin              4      30         4      30       um
//             mimcap_2p0_sin_3t           4      30         4      30       um
//             -------------------------------------------------------------------
//             **lt: length dimension of top metal
//             **wt: width dimension of top metal
//             **lt >= wt
//             **lay: metal layer number of stack-up, such as 1P6M, lay=6.
//         The CTM enclosure by CBM with 0.4um/per side is based on the minimum 
//  design rule 
//         for parasitic capacitance pre-simulation in PDK.
//             
// *************************************************************************************************
// *************************** 2 T 1p0 MiM cap ********************************************
subckt mimcap_1p0_sin ( top bottom ) 
parameters lt=10u wt=10u factor=1 mf=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_mim
parameters geo_fac=1/sqrt(mf*lt*factor*wt*factor*1e12) 
parameters factmis=0.0181*geo_fac*par_mim*mismatchflag 
parameters cmim_para=(1+factmis)*(((wt*factor+0.011u)*(lt*factor+0.011u)*1e12*1.0)+2*((wt*factor+0.011u)+(lt*factor+0.011u))*1e6*0.13)*1e-15*(1+(temp-25)*-3.75279e-5+(temp-25)*(temp-25)*-6.66927e-9) 

cmim ( top bottom ) bsource q=cmim_para*((1)*v(top,bottom)+(1/2)*v(top,bottom)*v(top,bottom)*6.88271e-5+
+ (1/3)*v(top,bottom)*v(top,bottom)*v(top,bottom)*-2.20387e-5)*cmimbb_mimfac*mf
c_soa ( top bottom ) capacitor c=1e-20 m=mf bv_max=13.2*(max(ov_ratio_mim/1.1,1))
ends mimcap_1p0_sin

//**************************** 3 T 1p0 MiM cap ********************************************
subckt mimcap_1p0_sin_3t ( top bottom gnode ) 
parameters lt=10u wt=10u lay=6 factor=1 mf=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_mim
parameters geo_fac=1/sqrt(mf*lt*factor*wt*factor*1e12) 
parameters factmis=0.0181*geo_fac*par_mim*mismatchflag 
parameters cmim_para=(1+factmis)*(((wt*factor+0.011u)*(lt*factor+0.011u)*1e12*1.0)+2*((wt*factor+0.011u)+(lt*factor+0.011u))*1e6*0.13)*1e-15*(1+(temp-25)*-3.75279e-5+(temp-25)*(temp-25)*-6.66927e-9) 
parameters cox_para=((lt*factor*1e6+0.8)*(wt*factor*1e6+0.8)*0.005071+2*((lt*factor*1e6+0.8)+(wt*factor*1e6+0.8))*0.0112)*1e-15 

cmim ( top bottom ) bsource q=cmim_para*((1)*v(top,bottom)+(1/2)*v(top,bottom)*v(top,bottom)*6.88271e-5+
+ (1/3)*v(top,bottom)*v(top,bottom)*v(top,bottom)*-2.20387e-5)*cmimbb_mimfac*mf
cox ( bottom gnode ) capacitor c=cox_para*((1/(15.90757+(4.14141672)*(lay-4)))/0.041337843)*cm5bb_mimfac*mf
c_soa ( top bottom ) capacitor c=1e-20 m=mf bv_max=13.2*(max(ov_ratio_mim/1.1,1))
//*
ends mimcap_1p0_sin_3t

//**************************** 2 T 2p0 MiM cap ********************************************
subckt mimcap_2p0_sin ( top bottom ) 
parameters lt=10u wt=10u factor=1 mf=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_mim
parameters geo_fac=1/sqrt(mf*lt*factor*wt*factor*1e12) 
parameters factmis=0.008586*geo_fac*par_mim*mismatchflag 
parameters cmim_para=(1+factmis)*(((wt*factor-0.01352u)*(lt*factor-0.01352u)*1e12*1.9804)+2*((wt*factor-0.01352u)+(lt*factor-0.01352u))*1e6*0.1090)*1e-15*(1+(temp-25)*2.7153e-5+(temp-25)*(temp-25)*2.9486e-8) 

cmim ( top bottom ) bsource q=cmim_para*((1)*v(top,bottom)+(1/2)*v(top,bottom)*v(top,bottom)*7.7898e-6+
+ (1/3)*v(top,bottom)*v(top,bottom)*v(top,bottom)*9.1979e-6)*cmimbb_mimfac*mf
c_soa ( top bottom ) capacitor c=1e-20 m=mf bv_max=5.5*(max(ov_ratio_mim/1.1,1))
ends mimcap_2p0_sin

//**************************** 3 T 2p0 MiM cap ********************************************
subckt mimcap_2p0_sin_3t ( top bottom gnode ) 
parameters lt=10u wt=10u lay=6 factor=1 mf=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_mim
parameters geo_fac=1/sqrt(mf*lt*factor*wt*factor*1e12) 
parameters factmis=0.008586*geo_fac*par_mim*mismatchflag 
parameters cmim_para=(1+factmis)*(((wt*factor-0.01352u)*(lt*factor-0.01352u)*1e12*1.9804)+2*((wt*factor-0.01352u)+(lt*factor-0.01352u))*1e6*0.1090)*1e-15*(1+(temp-25)*2.7153e-5+(temp-25)*(temp-25)*2.9486e-8) 
parameters cox_para=((lt*factor*1e6+0.8)*(wt*factor*1e6+0.8)*0.005071+2*((lt*factor*1e6+0.8)+(wt*factor*1e6+0.8))*0.0114)*1e-15 

cmim ( top bottom ) bsource q=cmim_para*((1)*v(top,bottom)+(1/2)*v(top,bottom)*v(top,bottom)*7.7898e-6+
+ (1/3)*v(top,bottom)*v(top,bottom)*v(top,bottom)*9.1979e-6)*cmimbb_mimfac*mf
cox ( bottom gnode ) capacitor c=cox_para*((1/(11.41604+(4.141672)*(lay-4)))/0.050763)*cm5bb_mimfac*mf
c_soa ( top bottom ) capacitor c=1e-20 m=mf bv_max=5.5*(max(ov_ratio_mim/1.1,1))
//*
ends mimcap_2p0_sin_3t
 
endsection mim

section rtmom
// ******************************************************************************************
//                                                                                          *
//            018 BB RTMOM                                                                  *
//                                                                                          *
//            parameter range: nv : 6~288, nh : 6~288                                       *
//                             nv and nh should be even fingers                             *
//                             w(width):0.28u ~0.32u                                        *
//                             s(spacing):0.28u ~0.32u                                      *
//                             stm(start metal layer):M1,M2,M3                              *
//                             spm(stop metal layer):M3,M4,M5                               *
//                             Total metal is at least 3 layers stacked with ploy shield    *
//                             mismatchflag : 0 represents no mis-match                     *
//                                            1 represents Parallel mis-match               *
//                                                                                          *
//                                                                                          *
// ******************************************************************************************
subckt crtmom ( a b p ) 
parameters nv=32 nh=32 w=0.28u s=0.28u stm=1 spm=5 factor=1 mf=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_rtmom 
+ layno=spm - stm + 1 laym1=int(layno / spm) layodd=int((layno + (stm - 2) * (stm 
+ - 3) * (stm - 4) * (stm - 5) / (24) + (stm - 1) * (stm - 2) * (stm - 4) * (stm 
+ - 5) / (4) + (stm - 1) * (stm - 2) * (stm - 3) * (stm - 4) / 24) / 2) - laym1 
+ layeven=int((layno + (stm - 1) * (stm - 3) * (stm - 4) * (stm - 5) / ( - 6) + 
+ (stm - 1) * (stm - 2) * (stm - 3) * (stm - 5) / ( - 6)) / 2) edg=((layodd + 5300 
+ / 5300 * laym1) * (nv - 1) * (nh * (w * factor + s * factor) - s * factor) + layeven 
+ * (nh - 1) * (nv * (w * factor + s * factor) - s * factor)) area=nv * nh / 2 * 
+ w * factor * (layno - 1) fri1=(2 * nh * nv * w * factor) * (layno - 1) fri2=((layodd 
+ + laym1) * nv * w * factor + layeven * nh * w * factor) + layeven * (nv * (w * 
+ factor + s * factor) - s * factor + 0.5u) * 2 + layno * 0.28u * 2 + (layodd + 
+ 5300 / 5300 * laym1) * (nh * (w * factor + s * factor) - s * factor) * 2 abm=((nv 
+ * (w * factor + s * factor) - s * factor + (0.28u + 0.5u) * 2) + (nh * (w * factor 
+ + s * factor) - s * factor + 0.5u)) * 0.28u afm=(nv * w * factor * (nh * (w * 
+ factor + s * factor) - s * factor + 0.5u)) / 2 pf=(nh * (w * factor + s * factor) 
+ - s * factor + 0.5u) * (nv) * 2 / 2 + 2 * ((nv * (w * factor + s * factor) - s 
+ * factor + (0.5u + 0.28u) * 2) + (nh * (w * factor + s * factor) - s * factor 
+ + 0.5u + 0.28u)) pfb=((nh * (w * factor + s * factor) - s * factor) + 0.5u + 0.28u) 
+ * 2.7 cc1=0.023964608 / (s * factor * 1e6) - 0.000227392 / (w * factor * 1e6) 
+ - 0.000501253 / (s * factor * 1e6) / (w * factor * 1e6) + 0.008322715 cc2=0.0497 
+ cf=0.015000000 * (s * factor * 1e6) - 0.002500000 * (w * factor * 1e6) + 0.006250000 
+ * (s * factor * 1e6) * (w * factor * 1e6) + 0.001339500 ca=0.000000000 * (s * 
+ factor * 1e6) + 0.040000000 * (w * factor * 1e6) + 0.000000000 * (s * factor * 
+ 1e6) * (w * factor * 1e6) - 0.000100000 ca_p_a=((stm - 2) * (stm - 3) / (1 - 2) 
+ / (1 - 3) * (0.000000000) + (stm - 1) * (stm - 3) / (2 - 1) / (2 - 3) * (0.000000000) 
+ + (stm - 1) * (stm - 2) / (3 - 1) / (3 - 2) * (0.000000000)) ca_p_b=((stm - 2) 
+ * (stm - 3) / (1 - 2) / (1 - 3) * (0.065000000) + (stm - 1) * (stm - 3) / (2 - 
+ 1) / (2 - 3) * (0.017500000) + (stm - 1) * (stm - 2) / (3 - 1) / (3 - 2) * (0.010250000)) 
+ ca_p_c=((stm - 2) * (stm - 3) / (1 - 2) / (1 - 3) * (0.000000000) + (stm - 1) 
+ * (stm - 3) / (2 - 1) / (2 - 3) * (0.000000000) + (stm - 1) * (stm - 2) / (3 - 
+ 1) / (3 - 2) * (0.000000000)) ca_p_d=((stm - 2) * (stm - 3) / (1 - 2) / (1 - 3) 
+ * (0.000100000) + (stm - 1) * (stm - 3) / (2 - 1) / (2 - 3) * (0.000040000) + 
+ (stm - 1) * (stm - 2) / (3 - 1) / (3 - 2) * ( - 0.000019000)) cf_p_a=((stm - 2) 
+ * (stm - 3) / (1 - 2) / (1 - 3) * (0.031750000) + (stm - 1) * (stm - 3) / (2 - 
+ 1) / (2 - 3) * (0.005750000) + (stm - 1) * (stm - 2) / (3 - 1) / (3 - 2) * (0.002750000)) 
+ cf_p_b=((stm - 2) * (stm - 3) / (1 - 2) / (1 - 3) * (0.006000000) + (stm - 1) 
+ * (stm - 3) / (2 - 1) / (2 - 3) * ( - 0.002500000) + (stm - 1) * (stm - 2) / (3 
+ - 1) / (3 - 2) * ( - 0.002250000)) cf_p_c=((stm - 2) * (stm - 3) / (1 - 2) / (1 
+ - 3) * ( - 0.018750001) + (stm - 1) * (stm - 3) / (2 - 1) / (2 - 3) * (0.006250000) 
+ + (stm - 1) * (stm - 2) / (3 - 1) / (3 - 2) * (0.006250000)) cf_p_d=((stm - 2) 
+ * (stm - 3) / (1 - 2) / (1 - 3) * ( - 0.000779500) + (stm - 1) * (stm - 3) / (2 
+ - 1) / (2 - 3) * (0.001288500) + (stm - 1) * (stm - 2) / (3 - 1) / (3 - 2) * (0.001129500)) 
+ ca_p=(ca_p_a * (s * factor * 1e6) + ca_p_b * (w * factor * 1e6) + ca_p_c * (s 
+ * factor * 1e6) * (w * factor * 1e6) + ca_p_d) cf_p=cf_p_a * (s * factor * 1e6) 
+ + cf_p_b * (w * factor * 1e6) + cf_p_c * (s * factor * 1e6) * (w * factor * 1e6) 
+ + cf_p_d cc_p=0.0451 slope_mis=(0.01611) geo_fac=1 / sqrt(((cc1 * edg * 1e-9 + 
+ cf * 1e-9 * fri1 + ca * 1e-9 * area + cc2 * 1e-9 * fri2) + (ca_p * (abm + afm) 
+ / (w * factor * 1e6) * 1e-3 + cf_p * pf * 1e-9 + cc_p * pfb * 1e-9)) * 1e15 * 
+ mf) factmis=slope_mis * geo_fac * par_mom * mismatchflag 
//

subckt cfmom_m1_0d28_2t ( a b ) 
parameters nr=6 lr=10u spm=2 mf=1 factor=1 mismatchflag=mismatchflag_fmom wwt=0.28 
+ sst=0.28 wwi=0.28 ssi=0.28 wwb=0.28 ssb=0.28 ll=lr * 1e6 * factor stm=1 layno=spm 
+ - stm + 1 nt=nr ni=nt nb=ni tcc1=6.84 * 1e-6 tcc2=0.00372 * 1e-6 vcc1=0.1257 * 
+ 1e-6 vcc2=0.006541 * 1e-6 tfac=1 + tcc1 * (temp - 25) + tcc2 * (temp - 25) 
+ * (temp - 25) cfgt=0.09 * (1.118) cfgi=0.09 * (1.121) cfgb=0.09 * (1.105) cfgt_e=0.09 
+ * (1.170) cfgi_e=0.09 * (1.139) cfgb_e=0.09 * (1.150) cbust=0.06 * (1.5) cbusi=0.06 
+ * (1.5) cbusb=0.06 * (1.5) cfinger=(cfgt * (nt - 3) + cfgi * (ni - 3) * (layno 
+ - 2) + cfgb * (nb - 3)) * ll cedge=(cfgt_e + cfgi_e * (layno - 2) + cfgb_e) * 
+ ll * 2 cedge2=(cbust * wwt * nt + cbusi * wwi * ni * (layno - 2) + cbusb * wwb 
+ * nb) mis_a=((mismatchflag - 1) / (0 - 1) * (0) + (mismatchflag - 0) / (1 - 0) 
+ * (0.45)) mis_b=((mismatchflag - 1) / (0 - 1) * (0) + (mismatchflag - 0) / (1 
+ - 0) * (0.1)) mis_c=((mismatchflag - 1) / (0 - 1) * (0) + (mismatchflag - 0) / 
+ (1 - 0) * (0)) mis_d=((mismatchflag - 1) / (0 - 1) * (0) + (mismatchflag - 0) 
+ / (1 - 0) * (0.038)) geo_fac=1 / sqrt((cfinger + cedge + cedge2) * mf) mis=mis_a 
+ * (((geo_fac - mis_b) ** 2 + 0.000000000000000001) ** 0.5 + geo_fac) + mis_c * 
+ (((geo_fac - mis_b) ** 2 + 0.000000000000000001) ** 0.5 - geo_fac) + mis_d factmis=mis 
+ / 1.414 / 100 * par_fmom 
 
 
cab ( a b ) bsource q=(1+factmis)*(cfinger+cedge+cedge2)*(tfac)*(v(a,b)+vcc1*1/2*v(a,b)**2+vcc2*1/3*v(a,b)**3)*1e-015*mf*fmom_fac_m1_0d28
c_soa ( a b ) capacitor c=1e-20  m=mf  bv_max=77 * (max(ov_ratio_fmom / 1.1,1))
 
ends cfmom_m1_0d28_2t
